- **SPEC-12.5**: Every request must pass the global layers in this order, outermost first: security headers, CORS,
  response compression, request tracing, JSON body sanitising, then routing; the stack must wrap all seven trees and the
  fallback.
- **SPEC-12.6**: The security headers of SPEC-4.28 must be present on every response, including the fallback `404`, a
  CORS preflight answer, a `429` and a response produced by a route tree's own error normaliser.
- **SPEC-12.7**: Response bodies must be compressed with brotli when the request advertises `br` (also when it
  advertises `gzip` as well) and with gzip when it advertises `gzip` and not `br`, for bodies past the layer's 32-byte
  floor.
- **SPEC-12.8**: JSON body sanitising must run on the full pre-nesting path and must forward the body unchanged for
  paths beginning `/api/v1/bunyip/`, `/api/v1/rmm/alerts`, `/api/v1/rmm/status`, `/api/v1/stripe/`, `/api/v1/paypal/`
  and `/api/v1/webhooks/`, whose signatures cover the raw bytes (SPEC-4.38).
- **SPEC-12.9**: A JSON request whose declared `Content-Length` is at most 25 MiB must be read in full by the sanitiser
  whatever default body limit the route carries; one declaring more must be forwarded unread to the route's extractor; a
  body of unknown length that exceeds 25 MiB must be answered `413` with a message containing `The request body could
  not be read.` and a `warn` log naming the path.
- **SPEC-12.10**: Each route that accepts a file must carry its own body limit equal to its logical size cap plus 64 KiB
  of multipart framing (SPEC-4.24): ticket attachments and inline images, the tenant logo, KB article images, vCard
  uploads and branding assets; the tenant data import route must carry exactly 25 MiB; any other non-JSON body-reading
  route must keep axum's 2 MiB default.

### 12.3 CORS

- **SPEC-12.11**: The CORS layer must allow the methods `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, `PATCH` and `OPTIONS`, the
  request headers `Authorization`, `Content-Type`, `Accept` and `X-Forwarded-Host`, must allow credentials, must cache
  preflight answers for 600 seconds, and must expose no response headers.
- **SPEC-12.12**: A request whose `Origin` matches no `CORS_ORIGIN` entry, or that has none, must receive no
  `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header and must still be processed by the route; CORS is not an access control on the
  server side.
- **SPEC-12.13**: An `OPTIONS` request must be answered by the CORS layer itself and must never reach the JSON
  sanitiser, the auth middleware or any route.
- **SPEC-12.14**: `CORS_ORIGIN` entries must be trimmed and parsed exactly once, at router construction; matching a
  request must do no parsing, only byte comparison against the parsed rules.
- **SPEC-12.15**: An exact entry must match an `Origin` header byte for byte, case-sensitively, with no normalisation of
  the header.
- **SPEC-12.16**: A wildcard entry `https://*.<suffix>` or `http://*.<suffix>` must match an `Origin` only when the
  scheme prefix is identical, the host ends with `.<suffix>` compared byte for byte (a port written in the entry is part
  of the suffix) and the host is strictly longer than `.<suffix>`; any number of leading host labels must match, and
  neither the bare apex nor an empty leading label may.
- **SPEC-12.17**: A `CORS_ORIGIN` entry must panic the boot with a message beginning `CORS_ORIGIN` when it is empty,
  when a wildcard has no suffix after `<scheme>://*.`, when a wildcard suffix contains another `*` or contains no dot,
  when `*` appears anywhere outside the leading `<scheme>://*.` position, or when an exact entry is not a valid header
  value.

### 12.4 Operational endpoints

- **SPEC-12.18**: `GET /api/v1/health` must answer `200` with the body `OK` and perform no dependency check.
- **SPEC-12.19**: `GET /api/v1/ready` must answer `200` with
  `{"status":"ready","checks":{"db":"ok","infisical":"ok"|"skipped"}}` when both checks pass, and `503` with
  `"status":"not_ready"` and the failing check's value replaced by `error: <cause>` otherwise; every answer must be
  `application/json` and carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- **SPEC-12.20**: The readiness database check must run `SELECT 1` bounded to 3 seconds and must report `error: db ping
  exceeded 3s` when the bound passes without an answer, and the database error text when the database refuses.
- **SPEC-12.21**: The readiness Infisical check must run only when `INFISICAL_ADDRESS` is non-blank at the first
  `/ready` request of the process (a blank value counts as unset for the process lifetime), must `GET
  <address>/api/status` with a 1 second timeout, must report `ok` on a 2xx answer, `skipped` when unconfigured, and
  `error: <address>: <cause>` or `error: <address>: status <HTTP status>` on failure, failing readiness only in the last
  case.
- **SPEC-12.22**: `GET /api/v1/version` and `GET /api/v1/version/check` must be served without authentication;
  `/version` must answer a JSON object with exactly the keys `name`, `version`, `git_describe`, `git_hash` and
  `build_date`.
- **SPEC-12.23**: `GET /api/v1/providers` must be mounted without the authentication extractor (SPEC-3.75), and `GET
  /api/v1/admin/providers/status`, `GET /api/v1/admin/providers/status.html` and `POST
  /api/v1/admin/providers/status/refresh` must be mounted in the staff tree with the gates of SPEC-3.76 and SPEC-3.77.

### 12.5 The staff tree /api/v1

- **SPEC-12.24**: Inside `/api/v1` a request must pass, outermost first: the error-envelope normaliser, the
  platform-admin service extension, the settings service extension, the database extension, the contact-plane
  middleware, the staff authentication middleware, the first-visit demo-seed middleware, then the route (SPEC-15.2053
  through SPEC-15.2063 for seeding).
- **SPEC-12.25**: The staff authentication middleware must never reject a request on its own (SPEC-5.140): a route
  protected only by this tree's middleware is open, so every protected route must declare an extractor, and the routes
  open by design include `/health`, `/ready`, `/version`, `/version/check`, `/providers` and `GET
  /grants/invitations/by-token/{token}` (SPEC-5.246).
- **SPEC-12.26**: The gate extractors must behave as SPEC-5.152 through SPEC-5.155 state: `RequireAuth` answers `401`,
  `RequireAdmin`, `RequireManager` and `RequireFinance` answer `403` for a role outside their allow-list, and a module
  gate answers `404` when the module is disabled for the tenant.
- **SPEC-12.27**: A staff-tree handler declared with the dual-plane extractor must accept either a staff session or a
  contact bearer, which the contact-plane middleware attaches to `/api/v1` requests as well as to `/api/v1/contact`
  (SPEC-5.11 through SPEC-5.22).
- **SPEC-12.28**: `/auth` (sign-in, sessions, MFA, password lifecycle) and `/my-grants` (grantee leave) must be mounted
  in the staff tree; `/grants/invitations` must require an admin session, `/my-grants/invitations` and the by-token
  `accept` and `decline` routes any authenticated caller (SPEC-5.27 through SPEC-5.98, SPEC-5.100 through SPEC-5.262).
- **SPEC-12.29**: `/platform` must be a separate credential plane: `POST /platform/login` takes email, password and MFA
  proof against the platform-admin store, and the `/platform/me/*` routes take the platform-admin bearer (its own token
  type), never a tenant session; `/tenants`, `/teams` and `/me` must exist only in builds with the `multi-tenant`
  feature, which is enabled by default; `/members` must require the manager role (SPEC-5.300 through SPEC-5.390,
  SPEC-5.500 through SPEC-5.571).
- **SPEC-12.30**: `/contacts` (companies, contacts, sites), `/portal-roles`, `/integrations/contact-sync` and the
  company branding uploads are session routes (SPEC-15.1 through SPEC-15.130, SPEC-15.500 through SPEC-15.691,
  SPEC-15.2081 through SPEC-15.2100, SPEC-5.400 through SPEC-5.499).
- **SPEC-12.31**: Tickets and their attachments, ticket templates, SLA, workflow rules, forms, email intake, calendar,
  dispatch, projects, approvals and notifications are specified at SPEC-7.1 through SPEC-7.630; the calendar and
  dispatch routes are gated by the `calendar` module, projects by `projects`, workflow rules, ticket templates, form
  definitions and email-intake tokens by `RequireAdminUser`, and the intake endpoint by its tenant bearer token.
- **SPEC-12.32**: Invoices, payments, payment gateways, tax rates, quotes, vendors, bills and issuer mappings must be
  gated by the `billing` module and contracts by `contracts`, and many of their routes must also require
  `RequireFinance`, as each handler declares (SPEC-13.1 through SPEC-13.1395, SPEC-14.57 through SPEC-14.81); time
  entries, timers, work days, mileage and work types must be gated by `time_tracking` and timesheet and approval routes
  by `timesheets` (SPEC-14.1 through SPEC-14.56); opportunities are specified at SPEC-14.82 through SPEC-14.91.
- **SPEC-12.33**: Assets, the asset catalog and company documentation are gated by `assets`, the knowledge base by
  `knowledge_base`, RMM connections by `rmm_integration` with `RequireAdmin` on writes, and reports by `reports`
  (SPEC-15.1000 through SPEC-15.1154, SPEC-15.1536 through SPEC-15.1575, SPEC-15.1576 through SPEC-15.1652).
- **SPEC-12.34**: The audit-log list and CSV export, the IP enrichment lookup, the tenant data export, import and
  demo-data load must require `RequireAdmin`, while the per-entity audit history needs only an authenticated session;
  the deployment-wide settings (email relay, application name, Google contacts client) and the feature toggles must
  require the deployment operator (SPEC-5.327, SPEC-5.500 through SPEC-5.571, SPEC-5.303 through SPEC-5.305,
  SPEC-15.2000 through SPEC-15.2052, SPEC-15.2101 through SPEC-15.2130); the integrations catalog is specified at
  SPEC-15.1500 through SPEC-15.1535.

### 12.6 The unauthenticated tree /api/v1/public

- **SPEC-12.35**: Every request to `/api/v1/public` must be charged to a per-client-IP budget of 60 per minute (client
  IP: SPEC-4.8 through SPEC-4.16), and a request past the budget must be answered `429` with a `Retry-After` header
  (SPEC-4.55) before reaching any route.
- **SPEC-12.36**: `/api/v1/public` must serve, with no session: `GET /config`, `GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/logo`, `GET
  /tenants/{tenant_id}/{asset}`, `GET /companies/{company_id}/{asset}`, `GET /kb/attachments/{attachment_id}`, `GET
  /tickets/attachments/{attachment_id}`, `GET` and `POST /request-forms/{token}`, and the three OAuth callbacks `GET
  /contact-sync/google/callback`, `/contact-sync/microsoft/callback` and `/invoice-issuer/{provider}/callback`; stored
  content is addressed by the id in the path, the request-form routes by a link token and the callbacks by a single-use
  `state` (SPEC-7.205 through SPEC-7.308, SPEC-15.2081 through SPEC-15.2118).

### 12.7 The contact tree /api/v1/contact

- **SPEC-12.37**: `/api/v1/contact` must decode only contact tokens (token type `contact`), read from the
  `Authorization: Bearer` header and then the `mokosh:contact_token` cookie, so a staff bearer presented there is
  unauthenticated and the protected routes answer `401` (SPEC-5.428 through SPEC-5.434).
- **SPEC-12.38**: The contact-tree routes `PUT` and `DELETE /companies/self/{asset}` must be mounted behind the same
  contact-plane middleware as the rest of the tree, so a signed-in contact reaches them (SPEC-15.2094).
- **SPEC-12.39**: The contact tree must serve the authentication, session, MFA, branding, access-request, dashboard,
  portal-host-resolution and payment-method routes of SPEC-5.440 through SPEC-5.499.

### 12.8 Self-authenticated receivers

- **SPEC-12.40**: `/api/v1/bunyip` must carry no session middleware; the back-channel logout route must be mounted only
  when the identity-provider verifier exists and must answer the provider's own status codes without the error-envelope
  normaliser; the two webhook routes must run under the normaliser.
- **SPEC-12.41**: Each of `/api/v1/stripe`, `/api/v1/paypal` and `/api/v1/webhooks` must wrap its receiver in its own
  error-envelope normaliser and must verify the delivery over the raw body before parsing it (SPEC-13.710).
- **SPEC-12.42**: The self-authenticated endpoints are: `POST /api/v1/bunyip/webhooks/account-deleted`, `POST
  /api/v1/bunyip/webhooks/mokosh-grant-changed`, `POST /api/v1/bunyip/oauth2/backchannel-logout`, `POST
  /api/v1/stripe/webhooks/{tenant_id}`, `POST /api/v1/paypal/webhooks/{tenant_id}`, `POST /api/v1/webhooks/xero`, `POST
  /api/v1/webhooks/quickbooks` (this tree), and `POST /api/v1/rmm/alerts`, `POST /api/v1/rmm/status` and `POST
  /api/v1/email-intake` (inside `/api/v1`, with their own credentials).

### 12.9 Command line

- **SPEC-12.43**: The first-argument operator subcommands of `mokosh-server`, their arguments and their per-command
  behavior are those of SPEC-3.78 through SPEC-3.91; any other first argument, including `--help` and `--version`,
  starts the HTTP server.
- **SPEC-12.44**: An operator subcommand that fails must write `error: <cause chain>` to standard error and exit with
  status 1; one that succeeds must exit with status 0.
- **SPEC-12.45**: Before running an operator subcommand both binaries must load `.env.infisical` and then `.env` from
  the working directory, ignoring a missing file; an unreadable or malformed file must fail the command with `env file
  could not be loaded: <cause>` and a non-zero exit instead of being skipped.
- **SPEC-12.46**: `qa-seed`, `qa-teardown`, `showcase-seed`, `showcase-refresh` and `showcase-teardown` must connect
  with `DATABASE_URL` as both pools, fail with `failed to connect to database: <cause>` when they cannot, and on success
  print `<subcommand> complete for tenant <uuid>.` and one report line; the refusals for a missing, production or
  unmarked tenant are SPEC-15.2069 and SPEC-15.2076, and they write nothing.
- **SPEC-12.47**: `bootstrap-infisical` must print `Bootstrap complete.` with the project id, project slug, environment,
  identity id, client id and env file path, and must not print the admin password or the client secret.
- **SPEC-12.48**: `mokosh-bootstrap` with no argument, `--help` or `-h` must print its usage to standard error and exit
  0; `--version` or `-V` must print the build banner (`<name> <describe> (<hash>) built <date>`) to standard output and
  exit 0; an unknown subcommand is SPEC-3.93.
- **SPEC-12.49**: `mokosh-bootstrap` subcommands `dev-seed-portal` and `normalize-company-industries` must connect with
  `DATABASE_URL` as both pools and exit non-zero with `error: <cause>` on failure; `dev-seed-portal` refuses outside a
  development or test environment (SPEC-15.2064), and `normalize-company-industries` prints its report on success.

## 13. Billing

Normative requirements for `src/modules/billing/`, `src/modules/quotes/` and `src/modules/contracts/`. Each requirement is cited at its implementing site with a `// SPEC-13.<n>` comment.

### 13.1 Billing core domain and money-writing paths

- **SPEC-13.1**: The billing router must register these routes at absolute paths (no prefix): GET and POST `/invoices`;
  GET `/invoices/summary`; POST `/invoices/from-time-entries`; GET and PUT `/invoices/{invoice_id}`; POST
  `/invoices/{invoice_id}/write-off`, `/void`, `/amend` and `/pay`; GET `/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf`,
  `/delivery-options`, `/payments` and `/payment-readiness`; GET and POST `/products`; GET, PUT and DELETE
  `/products/{product_id}`; GET `/statements` and `/statements/pdf`; GET and POST `/credit-notes`; GET
  `/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}` and `/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/pdf`; POST `/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/void`;
  GET and POST `/payments`; DELETE `/payments/{payment_id}`; GET and PUT `/payment-gateways`; GET
  `/payment-gateways/webhook-endpoints` and `/payment-gateways/webhook-deliveries`; DELETE
  `/payment-gateways/{provider}`; POST `/payment-gateways/{provider}/check`; GET and POST `/tax-rates`; PUT and DELETE
  `/tax-rates/{id}`; GET `/tax-rates/lookup`; GET and POST `/payment-terms`; PUT and DELETE `/payment-terms/{id}`.
- **SPEC-13.2**: Every billing handler other than the seven dual-plane invoice handlers (list, summary, detail, pdf,
  pay, payment-readiness and the payments ledger) must require the billing module to be enabled for the caller's tenant
  (404 when disabled) and then the finance role (super_admin, admin or finance; any other role gets 403).
- **SPEC-13.3**: On the seven dual-plane invoice handlers a staff caller must be checked for the billing module first
  (404 NotFound "Billing module" when it is disabled for the tenant) and for the role second (403 "Insufficient
  permissions" unless super_admin, admin or finance); a staff session that carries no user must be refused with 401.
- **SPEC-13.4**: On the dual-plane invoice handlers a contact caller must hold capability invoices:read (list, summary,
  detail, payment-readiness, payments ledger), invoices:download_pdf (pdf) or invoices:pay (pay), and POST
  `/invoices/{id}/pay` with an amount must additionally hold invoices:pay_partial; a missing capability must refuse the
  request before any invoice is read.
- **SPEC-13.5**: For a contact caller, GET `/invoices` and GET `/invoices/summary` must ignore any company_id in the
  query and filter to the contact's own company, and must exclude draft invoices (status <> 'draft') in both the rows
  and the count/total; a client must not be able to set the exclude-draft flag through the query string.
- **SPEC-13.6**: For a contact caller, GET `/invoices/{id}`, GET `/invoices/{id}/pdf`, POST `/invoices/{id}/pay` and GET
  `/invoices/{id}/payment-readiness` on an invoice of another company must answer NotFound "Invoice" (404), and GET
  `/invoices/{id}/payments` must answer the same 404 because the contact's company is part of the invoice lookup.
- **SPEC-13.7**: GET `/invoices` must accept the filters company_id, status (exact match on the stored status string),
  contract_id, q (case-insensitive substring match on invoice_number or po_number) and overdue, must order by
  invoice_date unless a supported sort field is requested (an unsupported sort field must be rejected with an error, not
  ignored), and must return the page together with the total count of rows matching the same filters.
- **SPEC-13.8**: An invoice filter q longer than 200 characters must be rejected with a validation error before the
  service runs, on both GET `/invoices` and GET `/invoices/summary`.
- **SPEC-13.9**: GET `/invoices/summary` must return {count, total} where count is the number of invoices matching the
  same filters as the list and total is the sum of their total column (0 when none match), computed in one aggregate
  query rather than by paging rows.
- **SPEC-13.10**: The overdue filter must be evaluated against today in the tenant's configured time zone: overdue=true
  keeps invoices with status sent or partially_paid, balance_due > 0 and due_date before today; overdue=false keeps
  every invoice that does not satisfy that predicate, drafts and paid invoices included.
- **SPEC-13.11**: Every invoice returned by a list or detail read must carry is_overdue and days_overdue derived at read
  time in the tenant's day and stored nowhere: is_overdue is true and days_overdue is the number of days between
  due_date and today only when the status is sent or partially_paid, balance_due > 0 and due_date is before today;
  otherwise is_overdue is false and days_overdue is 0 (an invoice due today is not overdue).
- **SPEC-13.12**: GET `/invoices/{id}` must return the invoice with its lines ordered by sort_order then creation time,
  and with company_name, payment_term_name, billing_contact_name (first and last name joined, null when both blank),
  written_off_by_name, voided_by_name and delivered_by_name resolved; an id outside the caller's tenant must answer 404
  "Invoice".
- **SPEC-13.13**: When an invoice names a billing contact, write-off user, voiding user or delivering user whose name
  cannot be resolved (row missing or both names blank), the response must carry null for that name and the unresolved
  ids must be logged through the unresolved-person helper under "billing.load_invoice" (under "billing.list_invoices"
  for a list's billing contacts).
- **SPEC-13.14**: The invoice detail must carry amended_by (id, invoice_number, status) naming the newest invoice whose
  amends_invoice_id is this invoice, derived by lookup and never stored; it must be null on list rows.
- **SPEC-13.15**: List rows must have lines null and must carry company_name, payment_term_name and billing_contact_name
  resolved with one batched query per kind (not one per row), tenant-scoped so a foreign id resolves to nothing;
  written_off_by_name, voided_by_name, delivered_by_name and amended_by must be null on list rows.
- **SPEC-13.16**: An invoice response must omit delivery_method, delivery_note, delivered_by_id, delivered_by_name,
  external_provider, external_invoice_id and external_number when they are null, and must always carry the money fields
  subtotal, tax_amount, discount_amount, total, amount_paid, amount_credited and balance_due.
- **SPEC-13.17**: A stored invoice status, invoice line type or payment method that is not a member of its known set
  must not be silently presented or acted on as a different value (draft, service or other): the read, edit, void,
  write-off, credit or amend must fail with an error naming the offending value and the row.
- **SPEC-13.18**: POST `/invoices` must reject with 422 a body with no lines, a payment_terms longer than 20 characters,
  a currency longer than 3 characters, or a due_date earlier than invoice_date (reported on field due_date as "due_date
  must be on or after invoice_date"); a missing due_date is allowed, and quantity and unit_price may be negative
  (discount lines).
- **SPEC-13.19**: create_invoice must refuse a company_id that is not a company of the caller's tenant with 422 on field
  company_id ("must be a company of this organization"), a payment_term_id outside the tenant with 400 "payment_term_id
  does not reference a payment term in this tenant", a product_id outside the tenant with 400 "product_id does not name
  a product in this tenant", and a retired product with 400 "That product has been retired and cannot be put on a new
  document", leaving no invoice row, number or line behind.
- **SPEC-13.20**: Every invoice created by create_invoice, create_invoice_from_time_entries, the recurring generator and
  amend must take its number inside the creating transaction: under the tenant-sequence scheme (the default) by
  incrementing invoice_sequences.last_number under the row lock (seeding the row at 1 with prefix "INV-" on first use)
  and formatting the prefix plus six zero-padded digits (INV-000042), under the company-prefix scheme from the company's
  prefix and its own counter, recording the scheme in number_scheme; a rolled-back transaction must give the number back
  so numbers stay gapless.
- **SPEC-13.21**: A due date must be taken as given when the request names one (keeping the named term); otherwise it
  must be the invoice date plus the net_days of the named payment term, or of the tenant's active default term (lowest
  sort_order, then name) when none is named, or 30 days when the term has no net_days or no term exists; the term that
  supplied the count must be recorded on the invoice, and a retired default term must not be used.
- **SPEC-13.22**: A new invoice's currency must be the request's currency when given, else the tenant's default
  currency; an invoice must keep the currency it was issued in.
- **SPEC-13.23**: create_invoice must write the invoice in status draft with amount_paid 0, subtotal equal to the sum of
  quantity times unit_price over its lines, total equal to subtotal plus tax minus discount (tax and discount default to
  0, the tax then re-derived by the tax rule) and balance_due equal to total; its lines must be written in one batch
  with line total = quantity * unit_price, a billing contact the requested one (validated) else the company's default,
  and the invoice, lines, tax and audit Create row must commit or roll back together.
- **SPEC-13.24**: After the lines of an invoice are written by create, time-entry generation, recurring generation, or
  update (when lines, tax_rate_id or tax_amount is given), the tax must be recomputed in the same transaction: a given
  tax_amount is stored as given and records no rate; otherwise the rate is the named tax_rate_id (an active rate of the
  tenant, else 400 "tax_rate_id does not name an active tax rate in this tenant") or the tenant's active default rate
  (earliest created) or none; tax_amount = round(taxable line total * rate / 100, 2) half away from zero over lines with
  is_taxable true; the rate id and percent must be frozen on the invoice; subtotal, total (subtotal + tax - discount)
  and balance_due (total - amount_paid - amount_credited) must be rewritten without changing status.
- **SPEC-13.25**: A line written from a request must take is_taxable from its catalog product when product_id is set,
  otherwise from the request (default true); a recurring line must take the product's is_taxable, and true when the item
  names no product.
- **SPEC-13.26**: When the invoice dispatcher is wired and delegated issuing is enabled, create_invoice must, before
  writing anything locally, validate the company, the payment term and every line's product, resolve due date and
  currency, and ask the dispatcher to issue the invoice externally; a refusal must fail the request with no invoice row
  written and no number consumed; on success the local row must be created with status sent, sent_at now and
  external_provider, external_invoice_id and external_number recorded, leaving emailed_at, emailed_to and
  delivery_method null, and the guards already run before the provider call must not be run a second time. Without a
  dispatcher, with the switch off, or when the plan is local, the ordinary draft path must run unchanged.
- **SPEC-13.27**: POST `/invoices/from-time-entries` must refuse a company_id that is not a company of the tenant with
  422 on company_id before selecting any entry.
- **SPEC-13.28**: The generated invoice must include, in date then creation order, every time entry of the company that
  is entry_kind client, is_billable, has no invoice and has billing_status ready_to_bill (restricted to time_entry_ids
  when given), and every mileage entry of the company that is billable, uninvoiced and ready_to_bill (time_entry_ids
  never restricts mileage); selected rows must be locked FOR UPDATE so a concurrent generation cannot bill them twice.
- **SPEC-13.29**: When no time entry and no mileage entry is eligible, the request must fail 400 with a message that
  names the reason when entries exist (billable but not ready to bill, logged non-billable, already on an invoice,
  covered by a block-hours contract, each with its count and hours and correct singular/plural, followed by one next
  step), and exactly "No billable time or mileage entries found for this company" when the company has none of those.
- **SPEC-13.30**: A time-entry line must have quantity duration_minutes / 60, unit price the entry's hourly rate (0 when
  none), total the entry's total_amount else quantity * unit price, and a description built by the descriptions module;
  an entry with overage_hours > 0 must instead bill only the overage hours at its overage_rate, else its hourly rate,
  else 0, with total = overage hours * rate.
- **SPEC-13.31**: A mileage line must have line_type mileage, quantity distance_miles, unit price rate_per_mile (0 when
  none), total total_amount else quantity * unit price, sort_order continuing after the time lines, and description
  "Mileage" when neither address is set, otherwise "Mileage: <start> <arrow> <end>" using the arrow character U+2192 and
  an empty string for a missing address.
- **SPEC-13.32**: The generated invoice must be a draft dated the request's invoice_date or today in the caller's time
  zone, with due date from the request's due_date or else the tenant default-term rule, billing contact the requested
  one (validated) else the company's default, currency the request's or the tenant default, discount 0, and tax per the
  tax rule using the named tax_rate_id or the tenant default rate.
- **SPEC-13.33**: In the same transaction the source time entries and mileage entries must be set to billing_status
  billed with invoice_id of the new invoice, and an audit Create row must be written; a failure anywhere must roll the
  whole generation back.
- **SPEC-13.34**: generate_due_recurring_invoices must consider, for one tenant, the contracts with status active,
  billing_cycle other than one_time (a missing cycle is treated as monthly) and start_date on or before today, where
  today is the tenant's local date computed from the supplied instant, in id order.
- **SPEC-13.35**: The billing period of a contract must be the window [period_start, period_end] anchored at start_date
  and stepped by the contracts module's CycleStep for its billing_cycle that contains today, period_end being the day
  before the next period starts; a contract whose cycle is unknown or whose start_date is after today must be skipped,
  and so must a contract whose period_start is after its end_date (a period that started before end_date is still
  billed).
- **SPEC-13.36**: Before invoicing a contract for a period, the run must roll the unused prepaid hours of the period
  that ended the day before period_start into the new period; a rolled amount above zero must be logged at info with the
  contract id, a NotFound result must be ignored, and any other error must abort the tenant's run.
- **SPEC-13.37**: A contract must be invoiced for a period only for items whose billing_rule is every_period, or once
  with billed_at unset, ordered by sort_order then name; with no such item no invoice and no ledger row must be created,
  so an item added later is picked up on the next run.
- **SPEC-13.38**: A recurring invoice must be created at most once per (tenant, contract, period_start): the invoice
  header and a contract_invoice_runs row must be inserted in one transaction, and when the ledger insert conflicts the
  transaction must be abandoned (no invoice, no number consumed) and the contract skipped.
- **SPEC-13.39**: A recurring invoice must be a draft dated today (tenant day) with due date from the tenant
  default-term rule, payment_terms "net30", notes "Recurring billing for <period_start> to <period_end>", no purchase
  order number, the company's default billing contact (or none), the tenant default currency, and one service line per
  item with the item's own name, quantity and unit price (never re-read from the catalog), total quantity * unit price
  and the item's product link, followed by the tax rule with the tenant default rate and an audit Create row.
- **SPEC-13.40**: A once item must be claimed (billed_at set to now) inside the invoicing transaction by an update that
  matches only while billed_at is null; if the claim matches nothing the transaction must be abandoned and no invoice
  created, so the item is never billed twice.
- **SPEC-13.41**: The all-tenants recurring run must iterate every tenant with a system audit context, and when one
  tenant's generation fails it must log a warning with the tenant id and error and continue with the next; it must
  return the total number of invoices created.
- **SPEC-13.42**: The recurring-invoicing job must be named "recurring_invoicing", must run the all-tenants generation
  with the current time on every tick, must log an info line with the count only when invoices were created, and must
  return the run's error when the run itself fails.
- **SPEC-13.43**: The invoice-reminder job must be named "invoice_reminders"; each tick must run reminders for every
  tenant, log a warning with the tenant id and error for a tenant that fails and continue, log an info line with the
  sent count only when above zero, and return the run's error when the run itself fails.
- **SPEC-13.44**: send_due_reminders must send nothing and return an empty list when the service has no mailer.
- **SPEC-13.45**: A tenant's reminders must be claimed only when its reminder settings are enabled with a non-empty
  schedule and the tenant's local hour equals send_hour; candidates are invoices with status sent or partially_paid,
  balance_due > 0, due_date before the tenant's local date and no external_provider, ordered by due_date then
  invoice_number, and an invoice is reminded only when its days past due is a member of the schedule.
- **SPEC-13.46**: A reminder's recipient must be the invoice's emailed_to when non-blank, else the resolved billing
  contact's email; when none resolves the invoice must be skipped and a warning naming the invoice id and the reason
  logged.
- **SPEC-13.47**: Each reminder must be claimed by inserting an invoice_reminders row keyed (tenant, invoice, offset
  days) with conflicts ignored, so an invoice already reminded for that offset is skipped; all claims must commit before
  any mail is sent so that no transaction is open during delivery.
- **SPEC-13.48**: Each reminder mail must state the invoice number, the amount due as "<balance_due> <currency>" (USD
  when the currency is null), the due date and the days overdue, must attach the stored issued document when one exists,
  and must include the portal login link only when the tenant has a usable gateway and a portal origin is configured; a
  failed batch lookup of company portal ids must be logged as a warning and the generic login link used.
- **SPEC-13.49**: When checking gateway readiness fails during a reminder run, the reminders must still be sent without
  a pay link and the failure must be logged with the tenant id.
- **SPEC-13.50**: When the mailer refuses a reminder, a warning naming the invoice id and the error must be logged, the
  claim row must be deleted in a new transaction so the next run retries, and the invoice must not count as sent; a
  failure to delete the claim must propagate as an error.
- **SPEC-13.51**: GET `/tax-rates` must return the tenant's rates, inactive ones included, ordered default first then by
  name, paginated with the total count; an unsupported sort field must be rejected with an error.
- **SPEC-13.52**: POST `/tax-rates` must reject with 422 a name outside 1..100 characters or a rate that is negative,
  has more than 4 decimal places or exceeds 100; is_default defaults to false and is_active to true; creating a default
  rate must first clear is_default on every other rate of the tenant in the same transaction; an audit Create row must
  be written.
- **SPEC-13.53**: PUT `/tax-rates/{id}` must apply the same validation, clear is_default on the tenant's other rates
  when the update makes this rate the default, answer 404 "Tax rate" when the id is not the tenant's (rolling back any
  demotion), and write an audit Update row with before and after snapshots.
- **SPEC-13.54**: DELETE `/tax-rates/{id}` must answer 404 "Tax rate" when the id is not the tenant's, otherwise delete
  the rate and write an audit Delete row with the before snapshot.
- **SPEC-13.55**: GET `/tax-rates/lookup?name=` must return the active rate whose name equals the given name exactly,
  else the tenant's active default rate, else 404 "Tax rate"; a missing name parameter must be a client error.
- **SPEC-13.56**: GET `/payment-terms` must return the tenant's terms ordered by sort_order then name, paginated with
  the total count; an unsupported sort field must be rejected with an error; net_days must be null for a term with no
  count.
- **SPEC-13.57**: POST `/payment-terms` must reject with 422 a name outside 1..100 characters or net_days outside
  0..3650; is_default defaults to false, is_active to true and sort_order to 0; creating a default term must first clear
  is_default on the tenant's other terms in the same transaction; an audit Create row must be written.
- **SPEC-13.58**: PUT `/payment-terms/{id}` must apply the same validation, clear is_default on the tenant's other terms
  when the update makes this term the default, and answer 404 "Payment term" when the id is not the tenant's.
- **SPEC-13.59**: DELETE `/payment-terms/{id}` must answer 409 "Cannot delete this payment term: it is still referenced
  by an invoice" when an invoice references it, 404 "Payment term" when the id is not the tenant's, and otherwise delete
  it.
- **SPEC-13.60**: GET `/payment-gateways` must return the tenant's gateway rows ordered by provider, paginated with the
  total count, each with id, provider, is_active (whether the matching integration is connected, not the legacy column),
  is_test_mode, configured (true unless the legacy column holds an empty string), client_display_name and credentials
  (one entry per credential field of the provider with key, label, present, secret and a value that is whole for
  non-secret fields and only a tail for secret ones); a stored credential must never be returned in full.
- **SPEC-13.61**: When a gateway's credential cannot be read while listing, the list must still return that row with an
  empty credentials array and a warning naming the provider must be logged.
- **SPEC-13.62**: PUT `/payment-gateways` with is_active true for a provider outside the supported set (stripe, paypal)
  must fail 400 "Payment provider '<provider>' cannot be activated: it is not implemented. Supported: stripe, paypal"
  and change nothing; saving credentials for an unsupported provider while inactive is allowed.
- **SPEC-13.63**: When the request carries config, it must be serialized to JSON and written to the secret provider at
  the (tenant, provider) address before the database row is touched, the row storing config_encrypted NULL, and a failed
  secret write must fail the request with the row unchanged; when config is omitted or null the stored credential must
  be kept, and a first-time save without config must fail 400 "Config is required when first configuring a gateway".
- **SPEC-13.64**: Upsert must insert or update on (tenant, provider) and set is_test_mode (default true);
  client_display_name has three states (omitted keeps the stored value, empty after trim clears it to null, otherwise
  stores the trimmed value) and longer than 64 characters is 422 "Button label must be 64 characters or fewer.";
  activating a provider must not deactivate any other provider, and the provider's connection state must be written
  through the shared integrations writer so is_active (default false) is the integration's connected status.
- **SPEC-13.65**: Upsert must write one audit row in the same transaction, Create when no row existed for the provider
  and Update otherwise, whose before and after snapshots omit config_encrypted, and the response must report configured
  true, the persisted client_display_name and the credential fields re-read after the commit (an empty list with a
  logged warning naming the provider when unreadable).
- **SPEC-13.66**: DELETE `/payment-gateways/{provider}` must answer 400 "Unknown provider <p>" for a provider outside
  the known set, otherwise delete the row and the stored secret at its address, write an audit Delete row (credential
  column omitted) only when a row existed, and succeed as a no-op when none existed.
- **SPEC-13.67**: POST `/payment-gateways/{provider}/check` must answer 400 "Unknown provider <p>" for an unknown
  provider and 404 "No <provider> gateway is configured for this tenant." when no row exists; it must check the row
  whether or not it is active; when the credentials cannot be built into a provider it must answer 200 with one check
  named "Stored credentials" with outcome failed and the error text, otherwise one entry per provider check with name,
  outcome (passed, failed or not_checkable) and detail.
- **SPEC-13.68**: A gateway whose config_encrypted is null but whose secret is absent from the secret provider must
  produce a Configuration error (HTTP 500) saying the gateway claims its credential is in the secret provider but the
  provider has none; it must never be treated as not configured. A non-null config_encrypted must be decrypted with the
  deployment's encryption key.
- **SPEC-13.69**: GET `/payment-gateways/webhook-endpoints` must return, for every supported provider, {provider, url}
  where url is "<base>/api/v1/<provider>/webhooks/<caller's tenant id>" built from the configured public API base with
  trailing slashes trimmed, or null when no base is configured; the tenant must be the caller's and never a request
  value, and the answer must not depend on whether a gateway row exists.
- **SPEC-13.70**: GET `/payment-gateways/webhook-deliveries` must return the tenant's most recent webhook deliveries
  newest first, filtered to the trimmed non-empty provider query value when given and capped by limit (default 20,
  clamped to 1..100); a provider with no deliveries, including an unknown one, must yield an empty list rather than an
  error.
- **SPEC-13.71**: Recording a webhook delivery must write one payment_webhook_deliveries row (tenant, provider, outcome,
  event type, event id, invoice id, detail) on the migrator pool, and when the write fails must only log a warning
  naming the provider and outcome; it must never change the webhook's response.
- **SPEC-13.72**: Resolving the provider for an inbound webhook must look only at the named provider among the tenant's
  connected, supported gateways and return none (not an error) when it is not connected; a connected one whose
  credentials cannot be built must be an error.
- **SPEC-13.73**: Choosing the provider for a payment must consider only connected supported providers sorted by id:
  with no provider requested it must pick the only one, none when there are none, and refuse with 400 "This invoice can
  be paid with <a> or <b>. Say which one to use." when several; with a provider requested it must pick that one, return
  none when no provider is connected, and otherwise refuse with 400 "<requested> is not connected for this invoice. It
  can be paid with <a> or <b>."
- **SPEC-13.74**: A provider must count as usable only when its credentials can be built into a provider object; a
  connected provider that cannot be built must be omitted with a warning naming it and must never fail the read; usable
  providers must be returned with their label overrides, sorted by id.
- **SPEC-13.75**: A provider's pay-button label must be the admin's client_display_name override when non-blank after
  trim, else "Pay with card" for stripe, "Pay with PayPal" for paypal and "Pay with <id>" for any other provider.
- **SPEC-13.76**: GET `/invoices/{id}/payment-readiness` must return gateway_ready (any usable provider), providers (id
  and label per usable provider), button_label (the first provider's label, null when none), invoice_payable (status
  sent or partially_paid and balance_due > 0), balance_due_display (balance formatted in the invoice currency, USD when
  null), partial_payment_allowed (gateway ready, invoice payable and the caller holds invoices:pay_partial; always a
  boolean) and min_partial_amount_display (the formatted floor when partial payment is allowed, else null).
- **SPEC-13.77**: The minimum partial payment floor must be the larger of 1 (in the invoice currency) and the configured
  min_partial_amount, taken as the maximum across the tenant's connected gateways for the readiness response and the
  first checkout check, and for the single resolved provider for the second checkout check.
- **SPEC-13.78**: POST `/invoices/{id}/pay` must reject with 422 a success_url or cancel_url that is not a valid URL,
  before any gate or provider is consulted.
- **SPEC-13.79**: Creating a checkout session must refuse an invoice whose status is draft, pending, void or written_off
  with 409 "Invoice <number> cannot be paid in status '<status>'" and an invoice with balance_due <= 0 with 400 "Invoice
  has no outstanding balance to pay".
- **SPEC-13.80**: An absent amount must charge the full balance_due; a given amount must be at most balance_due (else
  400 "The requested amount <v> is above the invoice balance <b>.") and at least the tenant-wide floor (else 400 "The
  requested amount <v> is below the minimum partial payment <floor>."), both checked before the provider is resolved,
  and after the provider is resolved at least that provider's own floor (else 400 "The requested amount <v> is below the
  minimum partial payment <floor> for <provider>.").
- **SPEC-13.81**: When no connected supported provider is resolved the pay request must fail 400 "No active payment
  provider is configured for this account"; otherwise it must create a hosted checkout session for the amount in the
  invoice currency (USD when null), prefilled with the billing contact's email when known, carrying the request's
  success and cancel URLs, and answer {checkout_url}.
- **SPEC-13.82**: POST `/invoices/{id}/pay` must be limited to 20 attempts per minute per caller (the staff user id or
  the contact id, a nil id for a staff session without a user) and 10 per minute per invoice, answering 429 with the
  wait in seconds (at least 1) and the message "Too many payment attempts. Please wait a moment before trying again.";
  the check must run after the module, role and capability gates and before the company-scope check and any provider
  call, and both buckets are charged on every call.
- **SPEC-13.83**: Recording a gateway payment from a verified webhook must, under the invoice row lock, return false and
  write nothing when the invoice no longer exists, when its status is draft or pending (logged at error with invoice id
  and status), or when the amount exceeds total - amount_paid - amount_credited (logged at error with invoice id, amount
  and remaining); otherwise it must insert a payments row dated today with the provider's currency, the method paypal
  for provider paypal, credit_card for stripe and other for any other provider, gateway_transaction_id the provider
  reference and the raw event as gateway_response, recompute the invoice balance, write a system audit Create row
  without gateway_response, and return true.
- **SPEC-13.84**: Recording a gateway payment whose (tenant, gateway_transaction_id) already exists must insert nothing,
  change no invoice state and return false, so a redelivered event is a no-op.
- **SPEC-13.85**: Recording gateway refunds must find the payment whose gateway_transaction_id equals the provider
  reference; when none exists it must log a warning with the reference and write nothing; otherwise it must lock the
  payment's invoice first, insert one payment_refunds row per refund (idempotent on (tenant, provider_reference)) and
  recompute the invoice balance net of refunds.
- **SPEC-13.86**: delegated_invoice must find an invoice by (tenant, external_provider, external_invoice_id) and return
  its id, balance_due and currency, and tenant_for_external_organisation must map (provider, organisation id) to the
  tenant id recorded in integrations.external_organisation_id on the migrator pool, returning none when unmatched.
- **SPEC-13.87**: void_delegated_invoice must set status void and voided_at for an invoice whose external_provider
  equals the given provider and whose status is not already void, record void_reason "Voided in <provider>, which issued
  it" with no voided_by_id, write a system audit Update row and return true; when nothing matches it must change nothing
  and return false.
- **SPEC-13.88**: GET `/payments` must list the tenant's payments filtered by invoice_id and/or company_id, ordered by
  payment_date unless a supported sort is requested, with the total count, each carrying company_name and invoice_number
  resolved by batch (null when missing).
- **SPEC-13.89**: POST `/payments` must reject with 422 an amount that is zero or negative, has more than 2 decimal
  places, or is at least 10000000000.
- **SPEC-13.90**: create_payment against an invoice must lock the invoice row first and refuse with 404 "Invoice" when
  it is missing, 409 "Invoice in status '<status>' has not been sent, so a payment cannot be recorded against it. Send
  it first." when it is draft or pending, 400 "Payment amount <a> exceeds invoice balance due <r>" when the amount
  exceeds total - amount_paid - amount_credited, and 400 "Payment company_id does not match the invoice's company" when
  the company differs; a payment without an invoice requires a company of the tenant (422 on company_id).
- **SPEC-13.91**: A successful create_payment must insert the payments row, recompute the invoice balance in the same
  transaction, write an audit Create row without gateway_response, and return the payment with company_name and
  invoice_number.
- **SPEC-13.92**: DELETE `/payments/{id}` must answer 404 "Payment" when the id is not the tenant's, otherwise lock the
  linked invoice, delete the row, recompute the balance and write an audit Delete row without gateway_response, all in
  one transaction.
- **SPEC-13.93**: GET `/invoices/{id}/payments` must return {invoice_id, currency (USD when null), payments, refunds,
  total_paid, total_refunded} with payments newest first by payment_date then creation time and refunds newest first,
  each payment limited to id, payment_date, amount, payment_method, reference_number (omitted when null) and created_at
  and each refund to id, payment_id, amount and created_at; it must answer 404 "Invoice" when the invoice is missing or,
  for a contact, belongs to another company.
- **SPEC-13.94**: Every change to an invoice's money must recompute the invoice after taking its row lock, setting
  amount_paid = sum(payments) - sum(payment_refunds), amount_credited = sum(issued credit notes), balance_due = total -
  amount_paid - amount_credited, and status in this precedence: draft and pending unchanged; written_off when
  written_off_at is set; void when voided_at is set; paid when the balance is <= 0; partially_paid when amount_paid > 0;
  otherwise sent; paid_at must be kept or set to now when total - amount_paid <= 0 and cleared otherwise.
- **SPEC-13.95**: Payment, refund, credit-note and credit-note-void paths must lock the invoice row FOR UPDATE before
  reading its totals and recompute afterwards in the same transaction, so concurrent operations on one invoice serialize
  instead of losing a write.
- **SPEC-13.96**: PUT `/invoices/{id}` must refuse a body that contains skip_email with any value with 422 whose field
  error is on skip_email with code unknown_field, telling the caller to use delivery, and must not process the rest of
  the request.
- **SPEC-13.97**: A delivery with method other and a missing or blank note must be refused with 422 on delivery.note
  before any state is touched.
- **SPEC-13.98**: PUT `/invoices/{id}` must refuse status void or written_off with 422 (field status, code
  invalid_status_transition), because those states are owned by the void and write-off endpoints.
- **SPEC-13.99**: PUT `/invoices/{id}` on an invoice in a frozen status must answer 409: when the request changes
  company_id the message names the status and tells the caller to issue a credit note and invoice the right company,
  otherwise "Invoice in status '<status>' cannot be edited"; the status must be re-read under a row lock and refused the
  same way if a concurrent change froze it, and a missing invoice is 404 "Invoice".
- **SPEC-13.100**: When lines are given, update must check every product before deleting anything, then replace all
  lines atomically with one batch insert; an empty lines array must be rejected with 422 "At least one line item is
  required"; the subtotal becomes the sum of quantity * unit_price, otherwise the stored subtotal is kept.
- **SPEC-13.101**: Update must set total = subtotal + tax - discount and balance_due = total - amount_paid, where tax
  and discount default to the invoice's current values, and must re-run the tax rule when lines, tax_rate_id or
  tax_amount is given (using the named rate, else the invoice's frozen rate); an update that gives none of the three
  leaves the tax unchanged, and omitted header fields (contract, dates, notes, po_number, payment_terms, term) keep
  their stored values.
- **SPEC-13.102**: When payment_term_id is given without due_date, update must re-derive the due date from the invoice
  date (request's or stored) and that term; a given due_date wins; otherwise the due date is unchanged; a
  payment_term_id outside the tenant is 400 as on create.
- **SPEC-13.103**: A billing_contact_id given on update must be a contact of the invoice's (possibly new) company, else
  400 "billing_contact_id does not reference a contact of this company".
- **SPEC-13.104**: Moving a draft to another company must require the new company to belong to the tenant (422) and must
  be refused with 409 "This invoice cannot move from <from> to <to>: <why>" when payments are recorded against it, time
  or mileage entries are billed on it, it was generated from or names a contract, or a line names a ticket or project of
  a company other than the new one; the billing contact must be replaced by the one named in the request (or the
  resolved recipient) and otherwise cleared, and an audit row with event invoice.company_changed naming both companies
  must be written.
- **SPEC-13.105**: A first transition to sent with delivery email (the default when delivery is omitted) must resolve
  the recipient before changing anything: the request's or invoice's billing contact (the request's only, after a
  company move) else the company's default billing contact, which must have a non-blank email; otherwise it must fail
  409 with a sentence naming the company and the missing piece (no billing contact, contact without email, contact no
  longer exists, company no longer exists); the recipient must be recorded as the invoice's billing_contact_id when the
  request names none.
- **SPEC-13.106**: On the first transition to sent the invoice must be frozen in the same transaction: issuer_snapshot
  set once from the tenant's name and branding and never overwritten, sent_at stamped now, the issued PDF rendered from
  the about-to-commit state and stored, and the delivery recorded; the transaction must roll back if any part fails.
- **SPEC-13.107**: On delivery email the PDF must be mailed to the resolved address inside the transaction after the
  recipient contact has been granted portal read access to invoices; requests carrying a user id must be limited by a
  per-user hourly mail budget (429 when exceeded); on success the invoice must record emailed_at now, emailed_to,
  delivery_method email, a null delivery_note and delivered_by_id (kept when already set), and an audit row with event
  invoice.sent, method email, the address and the contact id must be written.
- **SPEC-13.108**: When the mailer refuses the invoice email the send must fail with an external-service error (502)
  "Could not email the invoice to <to>: <error>. The invoice has not been sent.", the transaction must roll back so the
  invoice stays unsent, a warning with invoice id, number, recipient and error must be logged, and an audit row with
  event invoice.send_failed (number, method email, address, reason) must be written in a new transaction; a failure to
  write that row must be logged at error without replacing the mail error.
- **SPEC-13.109**: On delivery postal or other no recipient may be resolved and no mail sent; the invoice must record
  delivery_method, the trimmed note when one was given and delivered_by_id (kept when already set), an info line must be
  logged, and an audit row with event invoice.sent, the method, the note and null address and contact must be written.
- **SPEC-13.110**: The invoice email must carry the invoice number, the amount due as "<balance_due> <currency>" (USD
  when null), the due date, the PDF and the portal login link only when a portal origin is configured and the tenant has
  a usable gateway (the company's portal handle when it has one, else the generic login); a failed gateway check or
  portal-id lookup must be logged and the mail sent without that part; a service without a mailer, or an unreadable
  organisation identity, must fail the email with a 502 external-service error.
- **SPEC-13.111**: Sending an amendment (a first send of an invoice with amends_invoice_id) must lock the original and
  require that it still exists (409 "The invoice this one amends no longer exists, so sending it would replace nothing.
  Raise it as an ordinary invoice instead.") and still has status sent with amount_paid 0 and amount_credited 0 (else
  409 naming the invoice, its status, paid and credited amounts and advising a credit note); when satisfied the original
  must be voided in the same transaction with voided_by_id the sender, void_reason "Replaced by invoice <number>" and
  balance_due 0, with its own audit Update row.
- **SPEC-13.112**: When the voided original is held by a provider and delegated issuing is enabled, the provider's copy
  must be voided inside the send transaction and a provider failure must fail the send; when delegation is disabled or
  no dispatcher exists the local void must stand and a warning naming the provider and external invoice id must be
  logged.
- **SPEC-13.113**: Update must write an audit Update row with before and after snapshots in the same transaction and
  return the refreshed invoice detail.
- **SPEC-13.114**: Delivery methods must be exactly the strings email, postal and other on the wire; any other value
  must be a request deserialization error.
- **SPEC-13.115**: GET `/invoices/{id}/delivery-options` must return methods email, postal and other in that order; for
  a frozen invoice all three unavailable with reason "This invoice is in status '<status>' and cannot be sent again.";
  otherwise postal and other available, and email available with the recipient when a mailer exists and the invoice's
  billing contact (else the company's default) has a non-blank email, else unavailable with the first applicable reason
  of "Email is not configured on this server", "No billing contact is set", "Billing contact no longer exists", "Billing
  contact is missing email address".
- **SPEC-13.116**: POST `/invoices/{id}/write-off` must require a reason of 1..2000 characters (422), lock the invoice,
  answer 404 "Invoice" when missing, 409 "Invoice <number> cannot be written off in status '<status>'" unless the status
  is sent or partially_paid, and 409 "Invoice <number> has nothing outstanding to write off" when balance_due <= 0;
  otherwise it must set status written_off, written_off_at now, written_off_by_id the caller, write_off_reason (trimmed)
  and write_off_amount equal to the balance_due at that moment, leave balance_due unchanged, write an audit Update row
  and return the invoice.
- **SPEC-13.117**: POST `/invoices/{id}/void` must lock the invoice, answer 404 "Invoice" when missing and 409 "Invoice
  <number> cannot be voided in status '<status>': the customer already holds it. Issue a credit note against it
  instead." unless the status is draft or pending; otherwise it must set status void, voided_at now, voided_by_id the
  caller and void_reason the trimmed reason (null when absent or blank; more than 2000 characters is 422), write an
  audit Update row and return the invoice.
- **SPEC-13.118**: POST `/invoices/{id}/amend` must lock the invoice and answer 404 "Invoice" when missing, and 409 when
  the status is not sent (separate messages for draft or pending: edit directly; void: nothing to replace; other
  statuses: issue a credit note), when amount_paid > 0, when amount_credited > 0, or when a draft or pending invoice
  already amends it (naming that invoice's number); otherwise it must create a new draft with the next invoice number,
  invoice_date today in the caller's zone, due date re-derived from the original's payment term, amends_invoice_id the
  original, copying company, billing contact, contract, payment_terms, term, subtotal, tax, discount, total, currency,
  notes, internal_notes, po_number and tax rate fields, with amount_paid and amount_credited 0, balance_due = total and
  no sent, email, issuer snapshot, payment, void or write-off data, copy every line (including time_entry_ids and
  product link), write an audit Create row, and leave the original untouched.
- **SPEC-13.119**: POST `/credit-notes` must require invoice_id, a reason of 1..2000 characters and at least one line,
  with each line description 1..1000 characters, and must refuse with 400 a line whose quantity or unit_price is not
  strictly positive ("A credit note line must have a positive quantity and unit price; the document as a whole is the
  credit"), a negative tax_amount ("A credit note's tax amount cannot be negative") and a total (sum of lines plus tax)
  of zero or less ("A credit note must credit something").
- **SPEC-13.120**: A credit note's invoice must exist (404 "Invoice"), be in a frozen status (else 400 "Invoice in
  status '<status>' can still be edited, so it does not need a credit note"), not be written_off (400 "This invoice has
  been written off; issuing a credit note against it would remove the same debt twice") or void (400 "This invoice was
  voided, so it charges nothing to credit"), and the note total must not exceed total - amount_credited (400 "A credit
  note for <t> exceeds what is left to credit on this invoice (<remaining> of <total>)"); payments do not reduce the
  credit limit. These checks must run under the invoice lock in a first transaction and again in the main transaction.
- **SPEC-13.121**: A created credit note must take the next number from credit_note_sequences (seeded at 1 with prefix
  "CN-", six digits), be issued immediately with issue_date the request's or today in the caller's zone, belong to the
  invoice's company, have currency the request's else the invoice's else the tenant default, store subtotal, tax, total
  and lines (one batch), recompute the invoice balance, render and store its PDF in the same transaction (addressed to
  the invoice's billing contact, current branding), write an audit Create row, and be returned with its lines.
- **SPEC-13.122**: When the credited invoice is held by a provider and delegated issuing is enabled, the provider's
  credit note must be issued before the local transaction opens (no invoice lock held across the call); a refusal must
  fail the request with nothing written locally; on success external_provider, external_credit_note_id and
  external_number must be recorded on the credit note; a credit the provider holds but would not apply must be logged as
  a warning with provider and reason without failing; an unknown provider name must fail with an internal error; with
  delegation disabled a warning must be logged and the local credit must stand.
- **SPEC-13.123**: POST `/credit-notes/{id}/void` must answer 404 "Credit note" when missing and 409 "This credit note
  is already void" when void; otherwise it must lock the invoice, set status void, voided_at and voided_by_id, recompute
  the invoice balance, void the provider's credit note inside the transaction when the note has one and delegation is
  enabled (a provider failure rolls everything back; an unknown provider is an internal error), log a warning and keep
  the local void when delegation is disabled, write an audit Update row and return the note.
- **SPEC-13.124**: GET `/credit-notes` must filter by company_id, invoice_id and status (at most 20 characters), order
  newest first (created_at, id), paginate with the total count and carry company_name and invoice_number on each row; an
  unsupported sort field must be rejected with an error; GET `/credit-notes/{id}` must return the note with its lines
  ordered by sort_order then id, or 404 "Credit note".
- **SPEC-13.125**: GET `/credit-notes/{id}/pdf` must return application/pdf as an attachment named
  "<credit_note_number>.pdf", using the stored issued bytes when present and otherwise a live render with the tenant's
  current branding.
- **SPEC-13.126**: GET `/statements` and GET `/statements/pdf` must reject a period_end before period_start with 400 "A
  statement's period cannot end before it starts" and an unknown company with 404 "Company".
- **SPEC-13.127**: A statement for [period_start, period_end] must list, from dated rows only, the invoices dated in the
  period whose status is not draft, pending or void, the payments dated in the period, refunds by their creation date,
  issued credit notes by issue_date and write-offs by written_off_at date, each in date order, and must not read
  balance_due or amount_paid.
- **SPEC-13.128**: opening_balance must be invoiced + refunded + recovered - paid - credited - written off over
  everything dated before period_start (recovered being payments dated on or after the write-off date of a written-off
  invoice), and closing_balance must equal opening_balance + total_invoiced + total_refunded + total_recovered -
  total_paid - total_credited - total_written_off, with total_recovered computed the same way for payments dated inside
  the period.
- **SPEC-13.129**: GET `/statements/pdf` must render the same statement as an application/pdf attachment named
  "statement-<period_start>-<period_end>.pdf" using the tenant's current branding and the company's current default
  billing contact, dated the day of the request.
- **SPEC-13.130**: GET `/products` must filter by is_active and q (case-insensitive substring of name or sku, trimmed,
  at most 200 characters), order by name and paginate; GET `/products/{id}` must answer 404 "Product" when missing; POST
  and PUT must require name 1..255 characters, sku 1..64 when present and unit 1..30 (default "each"), default
  is_taxable and is_active to true, trim name, unit and sku (a blank sku is stored as null) and write an audit row; a
  duplicate sku must answer 409 "Another product already uses that SKU", a duplicate name 409 "Another product already
  uses that name", and PUT on a missing product 404 "Product".
- **SPEC-13.131**: DELETE `/products/{id}` must answer 404 "Product" when missing, 409 "This product is on an invoice or
  a contract and cannot be deleted. Retire it instead by marking it inactive." when a document references it, and
  otherwise delete the product and write an audit Delete row.
- **SPEC-13.132**: A product named on a document line must belong to the tenant and be active; editing a product's price
  or tax flag must not alter lines already written.
- **SPEC-13.133**: invoice_issuer must return the issuer snapshot frozen on the invoice when present and parseable,
  otherwise the tenant's current branding; tenant_issuer must always return the current branding; a missing tenant must
  be 404 "Tenant".
- **SPEC-13.134**: The bill-to of a document must be the company's billing address when any billing address column is
  non-blank, else its postal address, with the named contact's name and email; a missing company must yield the name
  "Customer" with no address. A credit note must use its invoice's own billing contact and a statement the company's
  current default billing contact.
- **SPEC-13.135**: GET `/invoices/{id}/pdf` must answer 409 "This invoice was issued by <provider>, so its document is
  <provider>'s. Open it there[ as <number>]." for an invoice that has an external provider; must serve the stored issued
  bytes only for a frozen invoice and otherwise render live with the current issuer; must honor `?template=` only for
  staff on a non-frozen invoice (400 listing the valid keys for an unknown key, 400 "`template` is not accepted here:
  this document is the one issued for you" for a contact, 400 "This invoice has been issued, so its document is the one
  that was sent and cannot be re-rendered in another template" for a frozen invoice); and must respond application/pdf
  as an attachment named "<invoice_number>.pdf".
- **SPEC-13.136**: The one-shot gateway credential move must select every payment_gateway_configs row whose
  config_encrypted is not null (all tenants, oldest first, no batch cap) on the migrator pool and move each one
  independently; a failure on one must be logged at warn with tenant id, provider and error (never the credential),
  counted as failed and must leave that row unchanged; the pass must log an info summary with the moved and failed
  counts when any row was considered, and return the counts.
- **SPEC-13.137**: Moving one credential must decrypt the ciphertext with the deployment key (a decrypt failure leaves
  the row), write the plaintext to the secret provider with put_if_absent at the (tenant, provider) address, then read
  it back and require equality (otherwise a Configuration error and the row left as is), and only then set
  config_encrypted to NULL with an update that matches only while it is not null; when the address was already claimed
  the column must be cleared without overwriting the store.
- **SPEC-13.138**: The gateway credential move must be known to the one-shot runner by the name
  "gateway_credential_move".
- **SPEC-13.139**: Every product read (list, detail, create and update responses) must carry in_use, true exactly when
  an invoice line or a contract item references the product, computed in the same query that reads the product; it is
  advisory and the foreign-key refusal on delete remains the guard.
- **SPEC-13.140**: A statement write-off line must carry the invoice number, the write-off date, the frozen
  write_off_amount and the write_off_reason recorded on the invoice; a written-off invoice whose amount or reason is
  missing must be reported as an error naming the invoice rather than shown as 0 or an empty reason.

### 13.2 Billing document generation, numbering and issuer identity

- **SPEC-13.400**: A document's addressee block (`BillTo::lines`) must start with the addressee name, then each address
  line in order, then `Attn: <contact name>` when the contact name is non-blank after trimming, then the trimmed contact
  email when it is non-blank. A blank or whitespace-only contact name or email must produce no line.
- **SPEC-13.401**: An addressee with only a name must render as exactly one line, the name.
- **SPEC-13.402**: `postal_lines` must trim each of line 1, line 2 and country and must omit any that is absent or
  blank, so no empty line is produced.
- **SPEC-13.403**: `postal_lines` must compose one locality line from city, state and postal code: `<city>, <state>
  <postal>` when the city and at least one of state or postal code are present, the city alone when it is the only part,
  `<state> <postal>` (or whichever of the two is present) when there is no city, and no locality line when all three
  are absent or blank. The locality line must come after line 2 and before the country.
- **SPEC-13.404**: The issuer block (`issuer_lines`) must be, in order: the issuer name; `trading as <trading name>`
  when a trading name is set; the postal address split into one entry per line with carriage returns removed; the tax
  id; then the email, phone and website, each on its own line when set. An issuer with nothing but a name must render
  as one line.
- **SPEC-13.405**: The document footer (`footer_lines`) must contain `Payment terms: <terms>` when the terms are
  non-blank after trimming, followed by `<issuer name> - <contact>` where `<contact>` joins the set values of email,
  phone and website in that order with `  |  ` (two spaces, pipe, two spaces). The contact line must be omitted when
  none of the three is set.
- **SPEC-13.406**: Every generated document (invoice, credit note, statement) must apply the issuer's resolved template
  and accent colour through one shared function, so the three document kinds cannot disagree about the template.
- **SPEC-13.407**: A logo supplied to a document must be fitted into a box 45 mm wide and 20 mm high. When no logo bytes
  are supplied the document must carry no logo.
- **SPEC-13.408**: The invoice document must be titled `Invoice` with the invoice number as its subtitle, and must show
  a `From` column (the issuer block) beside a `Bill to` column (the addressee block).
- **SPEC-13.409**: The invoice `Details` section must list, in order, `Invoice number`, `Invoice date`, `Due date`,
  then `Payment terms`, then `PO number`. `Payment terms` must use the payment term lookup name when present, else the
  free-text payment terms, and must be omitted when neither exists. `PO number` must be omitted when absent. The
  document must not print the invoice status.
- **SPEC-13.410**: The invoice footer must carry the same resolved payment terms as the `Payment terms` detail line.
  The credit note and statement footers must carry no payment terms.
- **SPEC-13.411**: The invoice `Items` table must be produced only when the invoice carries a lines list, with columns
  `Description`, `Qty`, `Unit price`, `Amount`. The first column must be left aligned and the other three right aligned.
  Quantity must print without trailing zeros, and unit price and amount must be formatted in the invoice's currency.
- **SPEC-13.412**: The invoice totals must list, in order: `Subtotal`, the tax row, `Discount`, `Total`, `Paid`,
  `Credited`, `Balance due`. `Discount` must appear only when the discount amount is non-zero, and `Credited` only when
  the credited amount is non-zero.
- **SPEC-13.413**: The invoice tax row must be labelled `Tax (<rate>%)` with the rate printed without trailing zeros
  when the invoice carries a non-zero tax rate, and `Tax` otherwise.
- **SPEC-13.414**: The invoice and the credit note must render a `Notes` section containing the notes text only when
  notes are present. The statement has no notes section.
- **SPEC-13.415**: The credit note document must be titled `Credit Note` with the credit note number as its subtitle,
  and must show a `From` column beside a `Credit to` column.
- **SPEC-13.416**: The credit note `Details` section must list, in order, `Credit note number`, `Issue date`, `Status`,
  `Reason`, then `Against invoice` with the invoice number only when the credit note names an invoice.
- **SPEC-13.417**: The credit note `Items` table must follow the same rules as the invoice items table (present only
  when lines exist, same columns and alignment, currency of the note), and its totals must be `Subtotal`, `Tax` and
  `Total credited`.
- **SPEC-13.418**: The statement document must be titled `Statement of Account` with the subtitle `<period start> to
  <period end>`, a `From` column beside an `Account` column, and an `Opening` section holding `Balance brought forward`.
- **SPEC-13.419**: Statement amounts must be formatted with two decimal places and no currency code.
- **SPEC-13.420**: The statement `Invoices` table must be produced only when the statement has invoices, with columns
  `Number`, `Date`, `Due`, `Status`, `Total`.
- **SPEC-13.421**: The statement `Payments` table must be produced only when the statement has payments, with columns
  `Date`, `Invoice`, `Method`, `Reference`, `Amount`. A payment with no invoice number or no reference must show an
  empty cell.
- **SPEC-13.422**: The statement `Refunds` table must be produced only when the statement has refunds, with columns
  `Date`, `Invoice`, `Amount`. A refund with no invoice number must show an empty cell.
- **SPEC-13.423**: The statement `Credit notes` table must be produced only when the statement has credit notes, with
  columns `Number`, `Date`, `Invoice`, `Reason`, `Total`. A credit note with no invoice number must show an empty cell.
- **SPEC-13.424**: The statement `Written off` table must be produced only when the statement has write-offs, with
  columns `Invoice`, `Date`, `Reason`, `Amount`, as a table separate from credit notes.
- **SPEC-13.425**: In every statement table the last (amount) column must be right aligned and all other columns left
  aligned.
- **SPEC-13.426**: The statement totals must list `Invoiced`, `Paid`, `Refunded`, `Credited`, then `Written off` only
  when the written-off total is non-zero, then `Balance due` showing the statement's closing balance.
- **SPEC-13.427**: An invoice and a credit note must be rendered from the issuer snapshot passed in (frozen at first
  send for an invoice), while a statement must be rendered from the current issuer, because a statement is stored
  nowhere.
- **SPEC-13.428**: `store_issued` must write the PDF bytes to the financial-document object key for the tenant and
  document id, and must return the storage error to the caller, without recording a ledger row, when the write fails.
- **SPEC-13.429**: `store_issued` must record the stored PDF in the files ledger inside the caller's transaction, so a
  rollback removes the row, with the name `<number>.pdf`, the type `application/pdf`, the byte length, no uploader, and
  the given entity type with the document id as entity id.
- **SPEC-13.430**: The ledger row id of a stored document PDF must be derived deterministically from the document id,
  must differ from the document id, and must be the same on every store of the same document, so a repeat store updates
  one row and cannot collide with a row keyed on the document id.
- **SPEC-13.431**: `read_issued` must return the stored PDF bytes for the tenant and document when they exist, and
  `None` for a draft or for a document issued without a stored copy, in which case the caller must render live. Any
  read failure also yields `None` (see defects).
- **SPEC-13.432**: A company invoice prefix must be exactly 4 characters, each drawn independently and uniformly from
  the 31-character alphabet `ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789`, which excludes I, L, O, 0 and 1. A prefix must not be
  derived from the company name.
- **SPEC-13.433**: The invoice number scheme must be `tenant_sequence` or `company_prefix`, recorded as those exact
  strings. Only the exact setting value `company_prefix` must select the per-company scheme; an absent value or any
  other value must select `tenant_sequence`.
- **SPEC-13.434**: `read_scheme` must read the tenant's `tenant_settings` row with category `billing_prefs` and key
  `invoice_numbering` on the caller's tenant-scoped connection, interpret a JSON string value, and select
  `tenant_sequence` when the row is absent or the value is not a string.
- **SPEC-13.435**: `ensure_company_prefix` must return the company's existing prefix when it has one, and must return a
  `NotFound("Company")` error when no company with that id exists in the caller's tenant.
- **SPEC-13.436**: `ensure_company_prefix` must assign a new prefix only where the company's prefix is still null, so
  two concurrent first invoices cannot overwrite each other: the writer that updates no row must read back and return
  the prefix the other writer installed.
- **SPEC-13.437**: When assigning a prefix hits a unique violation (SQLSTATE 23505, another company holds the draw),
  `ensure_company_prefix` must retry with a fresh draw, at most 5 draws in total. After 5 draws without success it must
  fail with an internal error reading `could not assign an invoice prefix for this company after several attempts`. Any
  other database error must be returned at once.
- **SPEC-13.438**: `next_company_number` must increment the `last_number` of the `(tenant, company)` sequence row and
  return the new value, and for a company with no sequence row must create it with `last_number` 1 and return 1. If a
  concurrent first invoice inserted the row first, it must increment that row and return the incremented value.
