- **SPEC-13.439**: `next_company_number` must run only on the caller's transaction connection, so a rolled-back create
  returns the number and leaves no gap, and a concurrent create must wait on the sequence row.
- **SPEC-13.440**: A per-company invoice number must be formatted `<prefix>-<sequence>` with the sequence zero padded to
  6 digits. A sequence above 999999 must print all its digits, not wrap or truncate.
- **SPEC-13.441**: A time-entry invoice line description must be `<date> <work type>` with the date as `YYYY-MM-DD` and
  the work type trimmed. It must append `: <detail>` only when there is ticket text or notes, and must carry no colon
  otherwise. Ticket text and notes in the detail must be joined with ` - `.
- **SPEC-13.442**: The ticket part of a time-entry line must be `<number> <title>` with both trimmed, the number
  alone or the title alone when the other is blank, and nothing when both are blank or no ticket is given.
- **SPEC-13.443**: The notes part of a time-entry line must be the first non-blank line of the notes, trimmed, and
  nothing when the notes are absent or blank. A first line longer than 120 characters must be cut to 120 characters with
  trailing whitespace trimmed and `...` appended; a line of exactly 120 characters must not be cut.
- **SPEC-13.444**: A block-overage time-entry line must be the ordinary time-entry description followed by ` -
  <overage>h over the <prepaid>h block` when the prepaid hours are greater than zero, and ` - <overage>h past an
  exhausted block` otherwise. Hours must print without trailing zeros.
- **SPEC-13.445**: `issuer::resolve` must trim every branding value and treat a blank value as unset. The issuer name
  must be the legal name, else the company name, else the tenant's own name, so it is never empty.
- **SPEC-13.446**: The issuer trading name must be the company name only when it is set and differs from the resolved
  name, otherwise `None`.
- **SPEC-13.447**: `issuer::resolve` must copy the postal address, tax id, support email, support phone, website, logo
  mime type and primary colour (as the accent) from the branding, trimmed and `None` when blank, and must leave the logo
  digest `None` and perform no storage access.
- **SPEC-13.448**: The issuer template must be Classic when `invoice_template` is unset or blank. An unrecognised key
  must resolve to Classic, must not fail, and must log a warning naming the key and the known keys.
- **SPEC-13.449**: An issuer snapshot stored without the template or accent keys must deserialize with the Classic
  template and no accent colour.
- **SPEC-13.450**: `freeze` must return the resolved issuer unchanged, with no logo digest, when no logo mime type is
  set. When one is set it must copy the logo and set the digest of the copy.
- **SPEC-13.451**: The logo copy made by `freeze` must read the tenant's current logo, compute its SHA-256 as lowercase
  hex, write the bytes to the branding-logo object key addressed by tenant and digest, and record a files-ledger row in
  the caller's transaction named `logo`, with the logo mime type, byte length, no uploader, entity type
  `branding_logo_snapshot`, the tenant id as entity id, and an id taken from the first 16 bytes of the digest, so equal
  logos share one row.
- **SPEC-13.452**: When the logo copy fails, `freeze` must not fail: it must log a warning with the tenant id and the
  error, clear the issuer's logo mime type, leave the digest unset, and keep every text value.
- **SPEC-13.453**: `logo_bytes` must return `None` when the snapshot has no digest, and otherwise the bytes of the
  branding-logo object addressed by tenant and digest, or `None` when that read fails (see defects).
- **SPEC-13.454**: `live_logo_bytes` must return `None` when the issuer has no logo mime type, and otherwise the
  tenant's current logo bytes, or `None` when the read fails (see defects). A malformed logo size limit in the
  environment must not affect the read.

### 13.3 Billing payment provider integrations and webhooks

- **SPEC-13.700**: The supported payment-provider set must be exactly `stripe` and `paypal`; `is_supported` must return
  true only for those exact lowercase strings, and false for `authorize_net`, the empty string and other casings such as
  `STRIPE` or `PayPal`.
- **SPEC-13.701**: `webhook_url(base, provider, tenant_id)` must return `<base>/api/v1/<provider>/webhooks/<tenant_id>`
  with every trailing `/` removed from the trimmed base, so a base written with one or more trailing slashes yields the
  same URL as one without.
- **SPEC-13.702**: `webhook_url` must return `None` (no URL, never a guess) when the base is absent or blank after
  trimming, and when the provider is not in the supported set.
- **SPEC-13.703**: `credential_specs` must declare for `stripe` the secret fields `secret_key` and `webhook_secret`, and
  for `paypal` the fields `client_id` (not secret), `client_secret` (secret) and `webhook_id` (not secret); it must
  return an empty list for any other provider, and the PayPal `sandbox` flag must not be declared as a credential.
- **SPEC-13.704**: `shown_value` must trim the stored value, return `None` when it is empty after trimming, and return a
  non-secret field in full.
- **SPEC-13.705**: `shown_value` must show a secret field only as its last four characters when the trimmed value is
  longer than 8 characters, and must return `None` (present but not shown) when it is 8 characters or fewer.
- **SPEC-13.706**: A credential check outcome must serialise as `passed`, `failed` or `not_checkable`; `not_checkable`
  must be used where the provider offers no way to verify a field, and must never be reported as `passed`.
- **SPEC-13.707**: A provider must refuse to build when any required credential field is empty or whitespace-only,
  failing with a `Configuration` error of the form `stored <Provider> config is missing <field>, <field>` that lists
  every blank field in declaration order.
- **SPEC-13.708**: `build(provider, plaintext, http)` must construct the Stripe or PayPal provider from the stored
  credential blob, and for any other discriminator (including `authorize_net`, the empty string and wrong casing) must
  fail with a `Configuration` error reading `payment provider "<value>" is configured but not implemented; supported:
  stripe, paypal`.
- **SPEC-13.709**: A built provider's `id()` must equal the discriminator it was built for (`stripe` or `paypal`).
- **SPEC-13.710**: Webhook verification must complete before the body is parsed or trusted, and a bad or missing
  signature must produce `Unauthorized`.
- **SPEC-13.711**: A gateway credential check must return one named check per stored credential; a provider that answers
  and refuses the credentials must yield a `failed` check in the list, and `Err` must be returned only when a call could
  not be made at all.
- **SPEC-13.712**: A provider with no saved-payment-method support must answer `create_setup_intent_session` with
  `BadRequest` reading `The <id> payment provider does not support saved payment methods.`
- **SPEC-13.713**: A provider with no saved-payment-method support must answer `detach_payment_method` with `BadRequest`
  reading `The <id> payment provider does not support detaching payment methods.`
- **SPEC-13.714**: The Stripe API base must be the `STRIPE_API_BASE` configuration value when it is non-empty, otherwise
  `https://api.stripe.com`.
- **SPEC-13.715**: Building a Stripe provider from a blob that is not valid JSON must fail with a `Configuration` error
  `stored Stripe config is not valid JSON` that does not include the blob text, and a blob with a blank `secret_key` or
  `webhook_secret` must fail with `stored Stripe config is missing <fields>`.
- **SPEC-13.716**: Creating a Stripe checkout session must convert the invoice amount to integer minor units at 100 per
  major unit, and an amount that cannot be converted must fail with `BadRequest` reading `Amount <amount> is out of
  range`.
- **SPEC-13.717**: A Stripe checkout session must be created with a form-encoded `POST <base>/v1/checkout/sessions`
  using the tenant's secret key as Bearer, `mode=payment`, one line item of quantity 1 named `Invoice <number>` in the
  lowercased currency, `client_reference_id` set to the invoice id, `tenant_id` and `invoice_id` metadata on both the
  session and the payment intent, and `customer_email` only when a recipient email is known.
- **SPEC-13.718**: A Stripe checkout call must fail with an external-service error for `stripe` when the request cannot
  be sent (`request failed: ...`), when the response is not JSON (`response not JSON: ...`), and on a non-success status
  (`checkout session failed (<status>): <Stripe error message or unknown error>`); the error text must not include the
  request or the key.
- **SPEC-13.719**: A successful Stripe checkout response with an empty or missing session `id` or `url` must fail with
  an external-service error `checkout session response missing id/url`.
- **SPEC-13.720**: A Stripe webhook without a `Stripe-Signature` header, or with a non-ASCII value, must be rejected
  with `Unauthorized` before the body is examined.
- **SPEC-13.721**: A Stripe webhook must be verified as an HMAC signature over the raw body with the tenant's webhook
  secret, at the current time and the shared default timestamp tolerance, and any verification failure must be
  `Unauthorized` with no distinction between causes.
- **SPEC-13.722**: A Stripe webhook whose signature verified but whose body is not a parseable event envelope must be
  rejected with `BadRequest` reading `Malformed Stripe event body`.
- **SPEC-13.723**: A Stripe `checkout.session.completed` event must be treated as a payment when `mode` is `payment` or
  absent, as a saved-card setup when `mode` is `setup`, and as `Ignored` for any other mode.
- **SPEC-13.724**: A Stripe payment session must map to `PaymentSucceeded` only when `payment_status` is `paid`,
  `payment_intent` is non-empty, `metadata.tenant_id` and `metadata.invoice_id` are valid UUIDs and `amount_total` is an
  integer; otherwise it must map to `Ignored` carrying the event type.
- **SPEC-13.725**: A Stripe `PaymentSucceeded` event must carry the payment intent id as the provider reference, the
  amount converted from minor units, the full event JSON, and the session currency uppercased, with `USD` used when the
  session carries no currency.
- **SPEC-13.726**: A Stripe `charge.refunded` event must map to `Refunded` with the payment intent id as the provider
  reference, the uppercased currency (`USD` when absent) and one refund line per entry of `refunds.data` that has a
  string id and an integer amount; entries lacking either are omitted, and an event with no non-empty payment intent or
  no refund lines must map to `Ignored`.
- **SPEC-13.727**: Every other Stripe event type must map to `Ignored` carrying the event type, so the receiver answers
  success and Stripe stops retrying.
- **SPEC-13.728**: A Stripe setup session must map to `PaymentMethodAttached` only when `status` is `complete`,
  `customer` is non-empty, a payment-method id is present (read from the expanded `setup_intent.payment_method` when
  `setup_intent` is an object, else from the session `payment_method`, as a string or an object `id`),
  `metadata.tenant_id` and `metadata.contact_id` are valid UUIDs, and the expanded card block gives a non-empty brand
  and last4 and non-zero `exp_month` and `exp_year`; otherwise it must map to `Ignored`. The brand must be lowercased.
- **SPEC-13.729**: A Stripe credential check must issue `GET <base>/v1/account` with the secret key as Bearer, report
  `Secret key` as passed on a success status, as failed with `<Stripe error message or "Stripe refused this key.">
  (<status>)` otherwise, and fail with an external-service error `request failed: ...` when the call cannot be made.
- **SPEC-13.730**: A Stripe credential check must report `Webhook signing secret` as `not_checkable` when the stored
  secret starts with `whsec_`, and as `failed` with the text `This does not look like a Stripe signing secret; they
  begin with whsec_.` otherwise.
- **SPEC-13.731**: A Stripe `capture` call must always fail with a `Configuration` error reading `stripe has no capture
  step; order "<id>" was routed to the wrong provider`.
- **SPEC-13.732**: A Stripe saved-card session must be created with a `POST <base>/v1/checkout/sessions` using
  `mode=setup`, `payment_method_types[0]=card`, `tenant_id` and `contact_id` metadata on both the session and the setup
  intent, and `customer_email` only when known; it must fail with an external-service error on a transport failure, a
  non-JSON response, a non-success status (`setup intent session failed (<status>): <message>`) or an empty `id` or
  `url` (`setup intent session response missing id/url`).
- **SPEC-13.733**: Detaching a Stripe payment method must reject an empty id with `BadRequest` `Empty PaymentMethod id
  cannot be detached.`, otherwise `POST <base>/v1/payment_methods/<id>/detach`; a success status or an error code
  `resource_missing` must succeed, and any other failure must be an external-service error `detach payment method failed
  (<status>): <message>`.
- **SPEC-13.734**: The PayPal API base must be the `PAYPAL_API_BASE` value (trimmed of trailing `/`) when it is
  non-blank, otherwise `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com` when the stored `sandbox` flag is true and
  `https://api-m.paypal.com` when it is false.
- **SPEC-13.735**: Building a PayPal provider from a blob that is not valid JSON must fail with a `Configuration` error
  `stored PayPal config is not valid JSON`, a blob with a blank `client_id`, `client_secret` or `webhook_id` must fail
  with `stored PayPal config is missing <fields>`, and an absent `sandbox` flag must mean false.
- **SPEC-13.736**: PayPal calls must authenticate with a client-credentials token from `POST <base>/v1/oauth2/token`
  using HTTP Basic client id and secret; the token must be cached per provider instance and reused until 300 seconds
  before its expiry.
- **SPEC-13.737**: A failed PayPal token request must produce an external-service error for `paypal`: `authentication
  failed (<status>): <error_description, else error, else unknown error>` on a non-success status, `token response
  missing access_token` when the token is absent or empty, and `token request failed` or `token response not JSON` for
  transport and parse failures; the credentials must not appear in the error.
- **SPEC-13.738**: A PayPal API response with an empty body must be read as no content, and a non-empty body that is not
  JSON must fail with an external-service error `response not JSON: ...`.
- **SPEC-13.739**: A PayPal checkout must create an order with `POST <base>/v2/checkout/orders`, `intent` `CAPTURE`, one
  purchase unit whose `reference_id` is the invoice id, whose `custom_id` is `<tenant_id>:<invoice_id>`, whose
  description is `Invoice <number>` and whose amount is the amount rounded to 2 decimals as a string in the uppercased
  currency, a `PAY_NOW` experience context carrying the success and cancel URLs, and the payer email only when known.
- **SPEC-13.740**: A PayPal order creation must fail with an external-service error `order creation failed (<status>):
  <first detail description, else message, else unknown error>` on a non-success status, and with `order response
  missing id or approve link` when the response lacks an order id or a link whose relation is `payer-action` or
  `approve`; the checkout URL must be the first such link.
- **SPEC-13.741**: A PayPal webhook missing any of the headers `paypal-transmission-id`, `paypal-transmission-time`,
  `paypal-transmission-sig`, `paypal-cert-url` or `paypal-auth-algo` (or carrying a non-ASCII value) must be rejected
  with `Unauthorized` before the body is parsed.
- **SPEC-13.742**: A PayPal webhook body that is not valid JSON or not valid UTF-8 must be rejected with `BadRequest`
  reading `Malformed PayPal event body`.
- **SPEC-13.743**: PayPal webhook verification must send the delivered body to PayPal byte for byte (never
  re-serialised, since key order changes the signature base) as `webhook_event` in `POST
  <base>/v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature`, together with the five transmission headers verbatim and the
  tenant's stored `webhook_id`.
- **SPEC-13.744**: When the PayPal verification call itself returns a non-success status the webhook must fail with an
  external-service error `webhook verification call failed (<status>)` (a non-401 failure, so PayPal retries).
- **SPEC-13.745**: When PayPal answers a verification call with a `verification_status` other than `SUCCESS`, the
  webhook must be rejected with `Unauthorized` and one `warn` log line carrying the event id, event type and returned
  status (`unknown` or `absent` when missing), and the body must not be logged.
- **SPEC-13.746**: A verified PayPal event without a string `event_type` must be rejected with `BadRequest` reading
  `PayPal event has no event_type`, and an event type that is not handled must map to `Ignored` carrying that type.
- **SPEC-13.747**: A PayPal `CHECKOUT.ORDER.APPROVED` event must map to `RequiresCapture` carrying the order id only
  when the first purchase unit's `custom_id` parses as `<tenant uuid>:<invoice uuid>` and the order id is non-empty;
  otherwise it must map to `Ignored`.
- **SPEC-13.748**: A PayPal `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` event must map to `PaymentSucceeded` (capture id as the provider
  reference, tenant and invoice from `custom_id`, the decimal `amount.value`, the uppercased `currency_code`, the full
  event JSON) only when the capture `status` is `COMPLETED`, `custom_id` parses, the id is non-empty and the amount
  parses; otherwise it must map to `Ignored`.
- **SPEC-13.749**: A PayPal `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED` event must map to `Refunded` with the capture id taken from the
  last path segment of the `up` link as the provider reference and a single refund line of the refund id and amount, and
  must map to `Ignored` when the `up` link, refund id or amount is missing.
- **SPEC-13.750**: A PayPal credential check must report `Client ID and secret` as passed when a token is obtained, and
  when it is not must return that check as failed with the token error text plus `Webhook ID` as `not_checkable` with
  `Checking the webhook needs working credentials.`; with a token it must `GET
  <base>/v1/notifications/webhooks/<webhook_id>` and report `Webhook ID` as passed on success or failed with `<message,
  else first detail description, else default text> (<status>)`.
- **SPEC-13.751**: Capturing a PayPal order must `POST <base>/v2/checkout/orders/<url-encoded id>/capture` with an empty
  JSON body and succeed on any success status or on a 422 whose first detail issue is `ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED`; any
  other outcome must be an external-service error `capture of order <id> failed (<status>): <message>`.
- **SPEC-13.752**: The provider webhook receiver must answer `POST /api/v1/{provider}/webhooks/{tenant_id}` outside
  session authentication, and a delivery must be authenticated only by the tenant's provider verification.
- **SPEC-13.753**: A delivery for a tenant with no active gateway for the route's provider must be answered `401
  Unauthorized` and must not write a delivery record, so an unauthenticated caller cannot add history to a tenant.
- **SPEC-13.754**: A delivery for a tenant whose gateway exists but cannot be built must record a delivery with outcome
  `failed` and the error text, and return that error.
- **SPEC-13.755**: A delivery whose resolved provider differs from the provider named by the route must be answered `401
  Unauthorized`.
- **SPEC-13.756**: After a gateway is resolved, every delivery must be recorded before the response is returned: an
  `Unauthorized` error as outcome `refused`, any other error as outcome `failed`, both with the error text and without
  event type or event id, and the error must be returned to the caller.
- **SPEC-13.757**: A handled delivery must be answered `200` with body `{"ok":true}` and recorded with its outcome,
  event type, event id and invoice id.
- **SPEC-13.758**: Event type and event id for a delivery record must be read only after verification, as `event_type`
  else `type` for the type and `id` for the id, only when they are JSON strings; a non-JSON body or non-string value
  must yield no identifier rather than a coerced one.
- **SPEC-13.759**: The receiver must verify the signature over the raw request bytes through the tenant's provider
  before any parsed content is acted on.
- **SPEC-13.760**: A `PaymentSucceeded` event whose tenant differs from the tenant in the URL must be rejected with
  `Unauthorized` (recorded as `refused`); otherwise it must be recorded as a gateway payment for the URL tenant, with
  outcome `accepted` when the payment was recorded and `unreconciled` when it was not, and the invoice id recorded in
  both cases.
- **SPEC-13.761**: A `Refunded` event must be recorded through the gateway refund path for the URL tenant, and a failure
  there must be returned as an error (recorded `failed`) so the provider retries.
- **SPEC-13.762**: A `RequiresCapture` event must call the provider's capture for the order id and write no payment
  itself; a capture failure must be returned as an error so the provider retries the approval.
- **SPEC-13.763**: A `PaymentMethodAttached` event whose tenant differs from the URL tenant must be rejected with
  `Unauthorized`; otherwise the saved card must be recorded for the contact under the route's provider, and a failure
  there must be returned as an error.
- **SPEC-13.764**: An `Ignored` event must be answered `200` with outcome `ignored` and a `debug` log naming the event
  kind and provider.
- **SPEC-13.765**: The Xero client must default to `https://identity.xero.com` for OAuth and `https://api.xero.com` for
  the Accounting API, both overridable per client, and must use a 45 second HTTP timeout.
- **SPEC-13.766**: Every Xero Accounting call must carry the access token as Bearer, the `Xero-Tenant-Id` header and
  `Accept: application/json`.
- **SPEC-13.767**: A Xero call answered `429` must be retried at most 3 times, sleeping the integer-seconds
  `Retry-After` value (60 seconds when absent or not an integer) before each retry; a `429` after the retries are used
  must fail as an internal error `Xero returned 429 ...: <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.768**: A Xero call must map status `401` to `Unauthorized`, `404` to `NotFound("Xero invoice")`, `409` to
  `Conflict("Xero refused the state transition")`, a `400` whose body contains `VOIDED` to `Conflict("Xero invoice is
  already voided")`, any other non-success to an internal error `Xero returned <status>: <body>`, a transport failure to
  `Xero HTTP call failed: ...`, and an unparseable success body to `Xero response was not JSON: ...`.
- **SPEC-13.769**: Refreshing a Xero token must `POST <identity>/connect/token` with Basic client credentials and
  `grant_type=refresh_token`, return the full token response (the refresh token rotates and the caller must store it),
  fail with `Unauthorized` when the failure body contains `invalid_grant`, and otherwise fail with an internal error
  `Xero token refresh returned <status>: <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.770**: A Xero or QuickBooks access token must count as near expiry when its expiry is at or before 60
  seconds from now.
- **SPEC-13.771**: Exchanging a Xero authorization code must `POST <identity>/connect/token` with
  `grant_type=authorization_code`, the code, the redirect URI and the PKCE code verifier, and a non-success answer must
  fail with `BadRequest` reading `Xero refused the connection (<status>). Start again from Settings. <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.772**: Listing Xero connections must `GET <api>/connections` with the Bearer token and no `Xero-Tenant-Id`,
  and a non-success answer must fail with an internal error `Xero connections returned <status>: <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.773**: Issuing a Xero invoice must `POST /api.xro/2.0/Invoices` with `Type` `ACCREC`, the contact id, the
  dates, the uppercased currency, the requested status and one line per input with quantity (hundredths) and unit price
  rendered as 2-decimal strings, and must return the Xero invoice id and number (empty string when Xero sends no
  number); a response with no invoice must fail with an internal error `Xero returned no invoice`.
- **SPEC-13.774**: Creating a Xero bill must `POST /api.xro/2.0/Invoices` with `Type` `ACCPAY` and status `AUTHORISED`,
  returning the bill id, and a response with no bill must fail with an internal error `Xero returned no bill`.
- **SPEC-13.775**: Voiding a Xero invoice must `POST /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/<id>` with `Status` `VOIDED`, and voiding an
  already voided invoice must surface as a `Conflict`.
- **SPEC-13.776**: Recording a Xero spend must `POST /api.xro/2.0/BankTransactions` with `Type` `SPEND`, status
  `AUTHORISED`, the bank account, the contact and one line per input with a 2-decimal `LineAmount` and `AccountCode`,
  returning the bank transaction id, and a response with none must fail with an internal error `Xero returned no bank
  transaction`.
- **SPEC-13.777**: Paying a Xero bill must `PUT /api.xro/2.0/Payments` linking the bill id, the bank account, the date
  and the amount as a 2-decimal string, returning the payment id, and a response with no payment must fail with an
  internal error `Xero returned no payment`.
- **SPEC-13.778**: Issuing a Xero credit note must `POST /api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes` with `Type` `ACCRECCREDIT`, status
  `AUTHORISED` and no due date, returning the credit note id and number (empty string when absent), and a response with
  none must fail with an internal error `Xero returned no credit note`.
- **SPEC-13.779**: Allocating a Xero credit note must `PUT /api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes/<id>/Allocations` with the invoice
  id, the amount as a 2-decimal string and the date, and a Xero refusal must be returned as an error.
- **SPEC-13.780**: Reading a Xero credit note must `GET /api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes/<id>` and return `None` for a `404` or
  an empty list, otherwise its status (`None` when the status string is unknown, never read as voided) and the ids of
  the allocations that carry one.
- **SPEC-13.781**: Removing a Xero credit-note allocation must `DELETE
  /api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes/<id>/Allocations/<allocation id>`.
- **SPEC-13.782**: Voiding a Xero credit note must `POST /api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes/<id>` with `Status` `VOIDED`, an
  already voided note surfacing as a `Conflict`.
- **SPEC-13.783**: Reading a Xero bill settlement must `GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/<id>` and return `None` when the
  document `Type` is not `ACCPAY` (case-insensitive), otherwise paid and total in minor units from `AmountPaid` and
  `Total` (a missing value read as 0) and `voided` true when the status is `VOIDED` or `DELETED`; a response with no
  document must fail with an internal error `Xero returned no document`.
- **SPEC-13.784**: Reading a Xero invoice status must `GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/<id>` and parse `DRAFT`, `SUBMITTED`,
  `AUTHORISED`, `PAID`, `VOIDED` and `DELETED`, failing with an internal error `unknown Xero invoice status: <value>`
  for any other value and `Xero returned no invoice` for an empty answer.
- **SPEC-13.785**: Xero money amounts must be rendered from integer minor units as decimal strings with a sign only for
  negative values (for example 12345 as `123.45`, -50 as `-0.50`), never through floating point.
- **SPEC-13.786**: The QuickBooks client must default to `https://oauth.platform.intuit.com` for OAuth and
  `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com` for the Accounting API, both overridable per client, use a 45 second HTTP timeout,
  and send `minorversion=70` and `Accept: application/json` with the Bearer token on every Accounting call under
  `/v3/company/<realm id>`.
- **SPEC-13.787**: A QuickBooks call answered `429` must be retried at most 3 times, sleeping the integer-seconds
  `Retry-After` value (60 seconds when absent or not an integer) before each retry; a `429` after the retries are used
  must fail as an internal error `QuickBooks returned 429 ...: <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.788**: A QuickBooks call must map status `401` to `Unauthorized`, `404` to `NotFound("QuickBooks invoice")`,
  a `400` whose body contains `Stale Object` to `Conflict("QuickBooks SyncToken is stale; refetch and retry")`, any
  other non-success to an internal error `QuickBooks returned <status>: <body>`, a transport failure to `QuickBooks HTTP
  call failed: ...`, and an unparseable success body to `QuickBooks response was not JSON: ...`.
- **SPEC-13.789**: Refreshing a QuickBooks token must `POST <identity>/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer` with Basic client
  credentials and `grant_type=refresh_token`, return the full token response, fail with `Unauthorized` when the failure
  body contains `invalid_grant`, and otherwise fail with an internal error `QuickBooks token refresh returned <status>:
  <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.790**: Exchanging a QuickBooks authorization code must `POST <identity>/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer` with
  `grant_type=authorization_code`, the code, the redirect URI and the PKCE code verifier, and a non-success answer must
  fail with `BadRequest` reading `QuickBooks refused the connection (<status>). Start again from Settings. <body>`.
- **SPEC-13.791**: Issuing a QuickBooks invoice must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/invoice` with the customer reference, the
  dates, the uppercased currency reference and one `SalesItemLineDetail` line per input carrying its item reference and
  a 2-decimal `Amount`, returning the invoice id and `DocNumber` (empty string when absent).
- **SPEC-13.792**: A QuickBooks invoice status must be derived from the invoice: `Voided` when `PrivateNote` contains
  `Voided`; `Draft` when the total is 0, the balance is 0 and a sync token exists; `Paid` when the balance is 0 and the
  total is above 0; `PartiallyPaid` when the balance is above 0 and below the total; `Sent` when the balance is at least
  the total and the total is above 0; otherwise `Draft`; an absent balance must be read as the total.
- **SPEC-13.793**: Reading a QuickBooks invoice status must `GET /v3/company/<realm>/invoice/<id>` and return the
  derived status, using the same derivation as the void target read.
- **SPEC-13.794**: Reading a QuickBooks invoice void target must return `None` for a `404`, otherwise the derived status
  and the current `SyncToken` (empty string when absent) from one read.
- **SPEC-13.795**: Voiding a QuickBooks invoice must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/invoice?operation=void` with the invoice
  `Id` and its current `SyncToken`.
- **SPEC-13.796**: Creating a QuickBooks bill must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/bill` with the vendor reference, the dates,
  the uppercased currency reference and one `AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail` line per input, returning the bill id.
- **SPEC-13.797**: Recording a QuickBooks spend must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/purchase` with `PaymentType` `Bank`, the
  bank account as `AccountRef`, one account-based line per input, the date and uppercased currency, and an `EntityRef`
  only when an entity id is given, returning the purchase id.
- **SPEC-13.798**: Paying a QuickBooks bill must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/billpayment` with the vendor, `PayType`
  `Check` with the bank account, the date, a 2-decimal `TotalAmt` and one line of the same amount linked to the bill
  with `TxnType` `Bill`, returning the payment id.
- **SPEC-13.799**: Issuing a QuickBooks credit memo must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/creditmemo` with the customer
  reference, the date (no due date), the uppercased currency reference and one `SalesItemLineDetail` line per input,
  returning the credit memo id and `DocNumber` (empty string when absent).
- **SPEC-13.800**: Applying a QuickBooks credit memo must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/payment` with `TotalAmt` `0.00` and
  two lines of the same amount, one linked to the invoice (`TxnType` `Invoice`) and one to the credit memo (`TxnType`
  `CreditMemo`), returning the payment id.
- **SPEC-13.801**: Reading a QuickBooks credit memo void target must `GET /v3/company/<realm>/creditmemo/<id>` and
  return `None` for a `404`, otherwise whether `PrivateNote` contains `voided` (case-insensitive) and the current
  `SyncToken` (empty string when absent).
- **SPEC-13.802**: Voiding a QuickBooks credit memo must `POST /v3/company/<realm>/creditmemo?operation=void` with the
  credit memo `Id` and its current `SyncToken`.
- **SPEC-13.803**: Reading a QuickBooks bill settlement must `GET /v3/company/<realm>/bill/<id>` and return `None` for a
  `404`, otherwise total and balance rounded to 2 decimals in minor units (an absent value read as 0), paid as total
  minus balance (not below zero) and `voided` always false.
- **SPEC-13.804**: QuickBooks money amounts sent on the wire must be rendered from integer minor units as decimal
  strings with a sign only for negative values (for example 12345 as `123.45`, -50 as `-0.50`).

### 13.4 Billing delegated invoice issuing (accounting systems)

- **SPEC-13.1000**: The delegated invoice-issuer provider set must be exactly `xero` and `quickbooks`; `as_str` must
  return the lowercase name and `parse` must return no provider for any other input, including the empty string and a
  differently cased name such as `Xero`.
- **SPEC-13.1001**: Converting a provider decimal string to minor units must trim surrounding whitespace, read one
  fractional digit as tenths (`70.5` is 7050), drop every fractional digit after the second without rounding (`70.999`
  is 7099), and apply a leading `-` as a negation of the whole amount (`-5.00` is -500).
- **SPEC-13.1002**: Converting a provider decimal string that has a non-numeric whole part or a non-digit fractional
  character must return 0 for that part instead of an error (`not a number` is 0), and the whole-part multiplication by
  100 must saturate rather than overflow.
- **SPEC-13.1003**: When the delegated invoice-issuer toggle is off, issuer selection must return the local path without
  evaluating either provider predicate, even when both providers are delegated.
- **SPEC-13.1004**: When the toggle is on, issuer selection must pick Xero if the Xero predicate is true (without
  evaluating the QuickBooks predicate), else QuickBooks if its predicate is true, else the local path, so a tenant with
  both providers delegated always gets Xero.
- **SPEC-13.1005**: `ExternalInvoicingProvider` must have exactly the variants Xero and QuickBooks; `as_str` must return
  `xero` or `quickbooks` and `parse` must return no provider for any other input, including `stripe` and the empty
  string.
- **SPEC-13.1006**: `DelegationDispatch::resolve` must return no provider (the local path) for an empty delegation set
  and the single provider for a set of one.
- **SPEC-13.1007**: `DelegationDispatch::resolve` must fail with a 409 conflict when two or more providers are
  delegated, with the message `Invoicing is delegated to more than one provider (<names>). Pick one under Settings >
  Integrations before issuing invoices.` where `<names>` lists the provider names comma-separated in the order given.
- **SPEC-13.1008**: `NotImplementedIssuer::issue` must always fail with an internal error (500) whose message names the
  provider (`xero` or `quickbooks`) and states the trait path is not implemented, and must make no call to any provider.
  Nothing in the production code constructs `DelegationDispatch` or `NotImplementedIssuer`.
- **SPEC-13.1009**: At boot the deployment's Xero and QuickBooks applications must be read through the application-tier
  secret seam; for each provider a client id and client secret are both required, and a value that is blank after
  trimming must count as absent.
- **SPEC-13.1010**: When both the client id and client secret of a provider are present the provider must be configured
  with the trimmed values and an optional webhook key (Xero webhook key, QuickBooks verifier token) that is `None` when
  absent or blank; a missing webhook key must not stop the boot.
- **SPEC-13.1011**: When neither the client id nor the client secret of a provider is present, that provider must be
  unconfigured (no application) without error, even if its webhook key is present, and the other provider must be
  resolved independently.
- **SPEC-13.1012**: When exactly one of a provider's client id and client secret is present, reading the applications
  must fail with a configuration error (500, `CONFIGURATION_ERROR`) whose message reads `<provider> invoicing is half
  configured: <present key> is set and <missing key> is not.` followed by the instruction to add the missing key or
  remove both, so the boot fails naming the missing key.
- **SPEC-13.1013**: Requiring an unconfigured provider's application must fail with a 409 conflict reading `<provider>
  invoicing is not available on this deployment: no <provider> application is configured for it.`
- **SPEC-13.1014**: The stored credential blob for a provider must be JSON tagged with a lowercase `provider` field
  (`xero` or `quickbooks`): Xero holds `refresh_token`, `access_token`, `access_token_expires_at` and `tenant_id`;
  QuickBooks holds `refresh_token`, `access_token`, `access_token_expires_at`, `realm_id` and an optional
  `refresh_token_expires_at`.
- **SPEC-13.1015**: Parsing a stored credential blob must fail with 401 unauthorized when no blob is stored, when the
  stored text is not a valid blob (logged at warn with the provider name), and when the blob's `provider` tag differs
  from the provider the caller expects (logged at warn with the expected provider).
- **SPEC-13.1016**: Applying a refreshed token response must replace the stored access token and refresh token and set
  the access-token expiry to the time of refresh plus `expires_in` seconds, treating a negative `expires_in` as 0.
- **SPEC-13.1017**: Applying a refreshed QuickBooks response must also set `refresh_token_expires_at` to the time of
  refresh plus `x_refresh_token_expires_in` seconds (negative treated as 0) only when the response carries that value,
  and must leave the stored value unchanged otherwise.
- **SPEC-13.1018**: Provider call credentials must be built as the deployment application's client id and client secret
  joined to the tenant blob's refresh token, access token, expiry and organisation (`tenant_id` for Xero, `realm_id` for
  QuickBooks), never taking a client id or secret from the tenant blob.
- **SPEC-13.1019**: Serialising a credential blob that cannot be serialised must fail with an internal error (500)
  naming the serialisation failure.
- **SPEC-13.1020**: The OAuth return address must be `<PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL without trailing
  slashes>/api/v1/public/invoice-issuer/<provider>/callback`; when the public API base is unset or blank after trimming,
  building it must fail with a configuration error (500) reading `PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL is not set, so <provider> has no
  address to return to.`
- **SPEC-13.1021**: Starting a connection must fail with 409 when the deployment has no application for the provider
  (before touching storage), and otherwise must store a single-use state row for the tenant (provider, starting user, an
  Argon2 hash of a 48-character random secret, the PKCE code verifier, the redirect address) expiring 10 minutes after
  creation, and return the state as `<state row id>.<secret>`.
- **SPEC-13.1022**: The consent URL must be `https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize` for Xero and
  `https://appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2` for QuickBooks, with percent-encoded query parameters `client_id`,
  `redirect_uri`, `response_type=code`, `scope`, `state`, `code_challenge` and `code_challenge_method=S256`, and must
  never contain the PKCE verifier.
- **SPEC-13.1023**: The requested scopes must be `offline_access accounting.transactions accounting.contacts` for Xero
  and `com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting` for QuickBooks.
- **SPEC-13.1024**: Consuming a connection state must accept only a value of the form `<uuid>.<secret>` whose row exists
  for the same provider, is not yet consumed, has not expired and whose secret verifies against the stored hash; every
  other case (malformed, unknown id, other provider, consumed, expired, wrong secret) must fail with 400 `That
  connection attempt is no longer valid. Start again from Settings.`
- **SPEC-13.1025**: When verifying the state secret itself errors (for example a corrupt stored hash), the state must be
  refused with the same 400 as a wrong secret and a warn log carrying the state id and the error.
- **SPEC-13.1026**: A connection state must be marked consumed before the code exchange runs, using an update
  conditional on it being unconsumed, so that of two concurrent callbacks with the same state only one proceeds and the
  other fails with the 400 above, and a failed exchange cannot be retried with the same state.
- **SPEC-13.1027**: Completing a connection must take the tenant solely from the consumed state row and scope every
  later write to it, and must fail with 409 when the deployment has no application for the provider.
- **SPEC-13.1028**: Completing a Xero connection must exchange the code with the stored verifier and redirect address,
  list the authorised organisations, and fail with 400 when none were authorised (`That Xero sign-in authorised no
  organisation. ...`) or when more than one was (`That Xero sign-in authorised <n> organisations. ...`) instead of
  choosing one; with exactly one it must store that organisation as the blob's `tenant_id`.
- **SPEC-13.1029**: Completing a QuickBooks connection must fail with 400 (`That QuickBooks sign-in named no company.
  Start again from Settings.`) before any code exchange when the callback `realmId` is missing or blank; otherwise it
  must store the trimmed realm as `realm_id` and record the refresh-token expiry only when the token response carries
  one.
- **SPEC-13.1030**: After a successful exchange, completing a connection must compute the access-token expiry as now
  plus `expires_in` seconds, write the credential blob to the tenant's integration secret key, record the connection,
  and return `<app base without trailing slashes>/settings/integrations` as the destination.
- **SPEC-13.1031**: Recording a connection must upsert the tenant's integration row for the provider with status
  `connected`, enabled capabilities exactly `invoicing` (replacing any previous capability set), the external
  organisation id, `connected_at` set to now and `last_error` cleared.
- **SPEC-13.1032**: Recording a connection must fail with 409 `Another tenant has already connected this <provider>
  organisation. Disconnect it there first, or contact support.` when the insert violates a unique constraint (Postgres
  23505, the cross-tenant organisation index); any other database error must propagate as an error.
- **SPEC-13.1033**: Disconnecting must delete the tenant's stored credential blob first and then set the integration row
  to status `disconnected` with `disconnected_at` set to now and `last_error` cleared, keeping its enabled capabilities;
  if the secret deletion fails the error must propagate and the row must stay unchanged, and a tenant with no row must
  complete without error.
- **SPEC-13.1034**: Setting bills delegation must fail with 409 `Connect <provider> before delegating bills to it.` when
  the tenant has no integration row and 409 `<provider> is not connected, so bills cannot be delegated to it.` when its
  status is not `connected`; otherwise it must remove the bills-and-expenses capability from the row's capability list
  and re-add it exactly once when `enabled` is true, leaving other capabilities untouched.
- **SPEC-13.1035**: Setting the payment account must fail with 409 `Connect <provider> before choosing the account to
  reimburse from.` when the tenant has no integration row and 409 `<provider> is not connected, so nothing can be
  reimbursed through it.` when its status is not `connected`; otherwise it must store the trimmed account id, or clear
  it when the value is null or blank.
- **SPEC-13.1036**: The connection overview must report `provider`, `configured` (the deployment holds an application),
  `status`, `delegated` (invoicing capability enabled), `bills_delegated` (bills-and-expenses capability enabled),
  `delegation_enabled` and `bills_delegation_enabled` (the deployment toggles), and must include `organisation_id`,
  `payment_account_id` and `last_error` only when set.
- **SPEC-13.1037**: For a tenant with no integration row the overview must answer success with status `not_connected`,
  `delegated` and `bills_delegated` false and no organisation, payment account or error, rather than an error.
- **SPEC-13.1038**: When the stored integration status is not a known status, the overview must report the status
  `error`.
- **SPEC-13.1039**: The admin routes must be `GET /api/v1/integrations/invoice-issuer/{provider}` (overview), `POST
  .../authorize` (answers `{"authorize_url": ...}`), `POST .../disconnect` (204), `PUT .../bills` with body `{"enabled":
  bool}` (204) and `PUT .../payment-account` with body `{"account_id": string or null}` (204); each must require an
  admin and act on the caller's own tenant.
- **SPEC-13.1040**: A `{provider}` path segment other than `xero` or `quickbooks` must fail with 404 `<raw> is not an
  invoice-issuer provider. The providers are: xero, quickbooks`.
- **SPEC-13.1041**: `GET /api/v1/public/invoice-issuer/{provider}/callback` must require no session and must always
  answer with a redirect to the SPA (never a JSON body): `<app base>/settings/integrations` after a successful
  connection and `<app base>/settings/integrations?connect=failed` for every failure, without placing the provider's
  error text in the URL.
- **SPEC-13.1042**: The callback must redirect to the failure URL, without completing anything, when the provider
  segment is unknown, when the query carries `error` (logged at info with the provider and the reason), or when `code`
  or `state` is missing; when completing fails it must log at warn with the provider and the error and redirect to the
  failure URL.
- **SPEC-13.1043**: The dispatcher's `delegation_enabled` and `bills_delegation_enabled` must reflect the deployment
  toggles for delegated invoice issuing and delegated bills respectively, each independent of the other.
- **SPEC-13.1044**: Planning an invoice must return the local path without querying any integration when the delegated
  invoice-issuer toggle is off.
- **SPEC-13.1045**: A tenant's invoices must count as delegated to a provider only when its integration status is
  `connected` or `error` and the invoicing capability is enabled; `disconnected`, not-connected and any other status
  must count as not delegated, and a failure reading the integration must propagate as an error.
- **SPEC-13.1046**: Planning an invoice must delegate to Xero when Xero is delegated, else to QuickBooks when it is,
  else return the local path, and a delegated plan must return the provider's invoice reference (external id and number)
  for the caller to store.
- **SPEC-13.1047**: Any failure after delegation was chosen (credentials, mapping, provider refusal) must be returned as
  an error so the caller never writes a local invoice the provider did not issue.
- **SPEC-13.1048**: Issuing through Xero must fail with 409 `Company <id> is not mapped to a Xero customer. Set the
  mapping at PUT /api/v1/invoice-issuer-mappings/companies/xero/<id> first.` when the company has no mapping, and with
  an internal error (500) when the mapped customer id is not a UUID; otherwise it must send the invoice with status
  `AUTHORISED` and each line's description, quantity in hundredths and unit price in minor units.
- **SPEC-13.1049**: Issuing through QuickBooks must fail with 409 when the company has no customer mapping (`Company
  <id> is not mapped to a QuickBooks customer. ...`), when a line has no product (`Every line of a QuickBooks-delegated
  invoice must link to a product. Set a product_id on each line before issuing.`), or when a line's product has no
  mapping (`Product <id> is not mapped to a QuickBooks item. ...`); otherwise it must send each line with its mapped
  item id and amount of quantity times unit price in minor units.
- **SPEC-13.1050**: Converting a decimal amount to minor units for a provider must multiply by 100 and round to a whole
  number, rounding a half away from zero to match the invoice line totals (1.235 is 124 and -1.235 is -124); quantities
  in hundredths use the same conversion.
- **SPEC-13.1051**: Converting a decimal amount that does not fit a 64-bit integer to minor units must not silently
  produce 0.
- **SPEC-13.1052**: Loading provider credentials must read the tenant's integration secret, fail with 401 when it is
  missing, malformed or tagged for another provider, and propagate any secret-store read error.
- **SPEC-13.1053**: Loading provider credentials must refresh the access token with the host application only when it is
  near expiry, apply the response and write the rotated blob back to the secret store before returning it; when the
  token is not near expiry it must not call the provider or write the store, and a refresh or write failure must
  propagate as an error.
- **SPEC-13.1054**: Loading provider credentials that need a refresh while the deployment has no application for the
  provider must fail with the 409 `... invoicing is not available on this deployment ...` conflict.
- **SPEC-13.1055**: Planning a bill must return the local path when the delegated bills toggle is off, and otherwise
  must choose Xero if its integration is `connected` or `error` with the bills-and-expenses capability, else QuickBooks
  under the same test, else the local path.
- **SPEC-13.1056**: Planning a delegated bill must fail with 409 `Vendor <id> is not mapped to a <provider> vendor. Set
  the mapping at PUT /api/v1/invoice-issuer-mappings/vendors/<provider>/<id> first.` when the vendor has no mapping, and
  for Xero with an internal error (500) when the mapped vendor id is not a UUID.
- **SPEC-13.1057**: Planning a delegated QuickBooks bill must fail with 409 when a line has no expense category (`Bill
  line '<description>' has no expense category ...`) or its category has no account mapping (`Expense category <id> is
  not mapped to a QuickBooks account. ...`); otherwise each line's amount must be unit price in minor units times
  quantity in hundredths divided by 100 using integer division, posted to the mapped account.
- **SPEC-13.1058**: Planning a delegated Xero bill must send each line's description, quantity in hundredths and unit
  price in minor units, and a successful delegated plan must return the provider's bill reference.
- **SPEC-13.1059**: Planning an expense reimbursement must return the local path when the delegated bills toggle is off
  or no provider is delegated (same provider choice as bills), and otherwise must fail with 409 `No <provider> account
  is set to reimburse from. Set it at PUT /api/v1/integrations/invoice-issuer/<provider>/payment-account first.` when no
  payment account is set.
- **SPEC-13.1060**: Planning an expense reimbursement must fail with 409 when a claim line has no expense category
  (`Claim line '<description>' has no expense category ...`) or its category has no account mapping for the provider.
- **SPEC-13.1061**: Planning a Xero reimbursement must fail with 409 naming `PUT
  /api/v1/invoice-issuer-mappings/people/xero/<user id>` when the claimant has no contact mapping, and with an internal
  error (500) when the mapped contact id is not a UUID; otherwise it must record a spend from the payment account to
  that contact with one line per claim line.
- **SPEC-13.1062**: Planning a QuickBooks reimbursement must record a purchase from the payment account with one line
  per claim line posted to the mapped account, naming the mapped contact as the entity when the claimant has a mapping
  and omitting it when not.
- **SPEC-13.1063**: Paying a delegated bill in the provider must fail with 409 `No <provider> account is set to pay
  from. ...` when no payment account is set; for Xero it must fail with an internal error (500) when the external bill
  id is not a UUID, otherwise pay against that bill; for QuickBooks it must fail with 409 naming the vendor mapping
  route when the vendor has no mapping, otherwise pay the mapped vendor; it must return the provider's payment id.
- **SPEC-13.1064**: Voiding a delegated invoice at the provider must first read its state and return `AlreadyVoided`
  without writing when Xero reports it voided or deleted, when QuickBooks reports it voided, or when QuickBooks no
  longer holds it; otherwise it must void it (using QuickBooks' current sync token) and return `Voided`, and a provider
  error must propagate.
- **SPEC-13.1065**: Issuing a credit note at Xero must fail with 409 when the company has no Xero customer mapping and
  otherwise create the credit note from the shape's lines, then allocate the whole credit total to the original invoice;
  a failed creation must be an error, while a failed allocation must still return the created credit note with an
  allocation result of `Refused` carrying the provider's error text.
- **SPEC-13.1066**: Issuing a credit note at Xero must reject an original invoice id that is not a UUID with an internal
  error (500) before creating anything at the provider.
- **SPEC-13.1067**: Issuing a credit note at QuickBooks must fail with 409 when the company has no customer mapping,
  when a line has no product (`Every line of a credit note against a QuickBooks-issued invoice must link to a product
  ...`) or when a line's product has no item mapping; otherwise it must create the credit memo and then apply the whole
  credit total to the original invoice, returning `Applied` with the application's payment id, or `Refused` with the
  provider's error text when only the application fails.
- **SPEC-13.1068**: Voiding a credit note at the provider must return `AlreadyVoided` without writing when the provider
  no longer holds it, when Xero reports it voided or deleted, or when QuickBooks reports it voided; otherwise Xero must
  delete every allocation on the credit note and then void it, and QuickBooks must void it using the current sync token,
  returning `Voided`, and any provider error must propagate.
- **SPEC-13.1069**: Reading a delegated bill's settlement must load fresh credentials and return the provider's paid
  total, document total and voided flag, or no settlement when the id is not a bill the provider holds.
- **SPEC-13.1070**: Reading an invoice's provider state must load fresh credentials and map Xero `Paid` to paid, Xero
  `Voided` or `Deleted` to voided, QuickBooks `Paid` to paid, QuickBooks `Voided` to voided, and every other status
  (draft, authorised, partially paid) to open.
- **SPEC-13.1071**: The dispatcher must expose the provider's webhook signing key from the deployment application (none
  when the provider is unconfigured or has no webhook key) without loading or refreshing any tenant credentials.
- **SPEC-13.1072**: Every invoice-issuer mapping read and write must run inside the caller's tenant scope and be keyed
  by tenant, provider and the Mokosh-side id (company, product, vendor, expense category or user).
- **SPEC-13.1073**: A single mapping lookup (customer, vendor, user) must return no mapping when none exists for that
  tenant, provider and id; the batched product and expense-account lookups must make no query and return an empty map
  for an empty id list, and must omit ids that have no mapping from the returned map.
- **SPEC-13.1074**: Reading the payment account must return no value both when the tenant has no integration row for the
  provider and when the stored account id is blank or whitespace.
- **SPEC-13.1075**: Listing mappings must return only the caller's tenant rows, ordered by provider then company id
  (companies), product id (products), category id (expense accounts) or user id (people), and vendors in creation order.
- **SPEC-13.1076**: Setting a mapping must trim the external id, fail with 400 `<field> cannot be blank`
  (`external_customer_id`, `external_item_id`, `external_vendor_id`, `external_account_id` or `external_contact_id`)
  when it is empty after trimming, and otherwise insert or replace the row for that tenant, provider and Mokosh id and
  return it.
- **SPEC-13.1077**: The mapping admin surface must expose under `/api/v1/invoice-issuer-mappings`: `GET companies`, `GET
  products`, `GET vendors`, `GET expense-accounts`, `GET people` (each answering `{"mappings": [...]}`) and `PUT
  companies/{provider}/{company_id}`, `PUT products/{provider}/{product_id}`, `PUT vendors/{provider}/{vendor_id}`, `PUT
  expense-accounts/{provider}/{category_id}`, `PUT people/{provider}/{user_id}` answering the stored mapping; no DELETE
  route may exist.
- **SPEC-13.1078**: Every mapping route must require the billing, finance and admin gates together; an unauthorised
  caller must be refused by those gates before the feature toggle is consulted.
- **SPEC-13.1079**: The company and product mapping routes must answer 404 `This endpoint is not enabled on this
  deployment` while the delegated invoice-issuer toggle is off, and the vendor, expense-account and people routes must
  answer the same 404 while the delegated bills toggle is off, each toggle gating only its own routes.
- **SPEC-13.1080**: A mapping PUT must read the body fields `external_customer_id`, `external_item_id`,
  `external_vendor_id`, `external_account_id` or `external_contact_id` respectively, check the toggle first, then reject
  a value shorter than 1 or longer than 100 characters with a 422 validation error, and only then parse the provider.
- **SPEC-13.1081**: A mapping PUT with a `{provider}` other than `xero` or `quickbooks` must fail with 400 `'<raw>' is
  not a delegated invoice-issuer provider; expected xero or quickbooks`.
- **SPEC-13.1082**: Webhook signature verification must base64-decode the trimmed header value and compare it in
  constant time with HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body under the key, and must return false (never panic or error) for a value
  that is not valid base64, an unusable key, a modified body or a different key; an empty body with a matching signature
  must verify.
- **SPEC-13.1083**: Xero deliveries must be accepted at `POST /api/v1/webhooks/xero` and QuickBooks deliveries at `POST
  /api/v1/webhooks/quickbooks`, one URL per provider with no tenant in the path.
- **SPEC-13.1084**: A delivery must be refused with 401 and nothing recorded when the deployment holds no webhook key
  (or a blank one) for the provider, when the signature header (`x-xero-signature` for Xero, `intuit-signature` for
  QuickBooks) is missing or not valid text, or when the signature does not verify against the raw body; the body must
  not be read before the signature verifies.
- **SPEC-13.1085**: A verified delivery whose body is not valid JSON of the provider's delivery shape must fail with 400
  `unreadable Xero delivery: <error>` or `unreadable QuickBooks delivery: <error>`, and a delivery with no events
  (Xero's activation check) must answer 200.
- **SPEC-13.1086**: Only invoice-type events must be processed: Xero events whose category is `INVOICE`
  (case-insensitive) and QuickBooks entities named `Invoice` or `Bill` (case-insensitive), each with a non-empty
  document id and a non-empty organisation id (Xero `tenantId`, QuickBooks `realmId`); all other events must be skipped,
  in the order the provider sent them.
- **SPEC-13.1087**: Each event's tenant must be resolved from its organisation id and the route's provider through the
  integration row; an event whose organisation no tenant holds must be skipped with an info log carrying the provider
  and organisation id and no delivery row, and must not stop the remaining events.
- **SPEC-13.1088**: For an event naming a delegated invoice, the webhook must read the provider's current invoice state
  rather than trust the payload: `paid` with a balance due above zero must record a payment of the whole balance due in
  the invoice currency keyed by the external invoice id and result in `accepted` when recorded and `unreconciled` when
  not; `paid` with no balance due, and `open`, must result in `ignored`; `voided` must void the local invoice and result
  in `accepted`.
- **SPEC-13.1089**: For an event naming no delegated invoice, the webhook must try a delegated bill of the tenant and
  result in `ignored` when there is none or when the provider does not hold the id as a bill; otherwise it must
  reconcile the provider's paid running total against the bill using today's UTC date and a system audit context,
  resulting in `accepted` when a payment was recorded and `ignored` when already level.
- **SPEC-13.1090**: When the provider reports a delegated bill voided, the webhook must not void the local bill, must
  log a warn carrying the bill id, and must result in `unreconciled`.
- **SPEC-13.1091**: After each processed event a delivery row must be recorded for the tenant and provider with outcome
  `accepted`, `ignored`, `unreconciled` or `failed`; for `failed` the row must carry the error text and the handler must
  stop at that event and return its error status (so the provider retries), while a failure to write the row must be
  logged at warn and must not change the response.
- **SPEC-13.1092**: A delivery whose events all processed without error must answer 200 with an empty body.

### 13.5 Quotes and contracts

- **SPEC-13.1300**: A staff caller of GET /contracts and GET /contracts/{id} must hold the role super_admin, admin or
  finance; any other staff role must receive 403 with message "Insufficient permissions", and a staff context with no
  user must receive 401. The tenant's contracts module toggle must not be consulted on these two reads.
- **SPEC-13.1301**: A contact-plane caller of GET /contracts must hold the contracts:read portal capability, otherwise
  the request must be refused by the capability check; the company_id query filter must be overwritten with the
  session's own company so a spoofed company_id never widens visibility.
- **SPEC-13.1302**: A contact-plane caller of GET /contracts/{id} must hold contracts:read, and a contract whose
  company_id differs from the session's company must answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Contract"), the same answer as a
  contract that does not exist.
- **SPEC-13.1303**: Contact-plane contract reads must return only id, company_id, contract_number, name, contract_type,
  status, start_date, end_date, billing_cycle and billing_amount; notes, sla_id, signed_by_contact_id, auto_renew,
  signed_date and timestamps must never appear, and every listed key must be present (null when unset).
- **SPEC-13.1304**: GET /contracts must return only the caller's tenant's contracts, optionally filtered by exact match
  on company_id, contract_type and status, ordered by start_date descending, paginated with the total count of the
  filtered set. contract_type and status filters longer than 100 characters must be rejected with a validation error,
  and any sort parameter must be rejected with a validation error naming `sort`.
- **SPEC-13.1305**: GET /contracts/{id} for an id that does not exist in the caller's tenant must answer 404 NOT_FOUND
  (resource "Contract"); the stored status must be reported as "draft", auto_renew as false and billing_cycle as
  "monthly" when the column is null.
- **SPEC-13.1306**: Every contracts, contract-item, hour-balance, rate-card and rate-card-item route other than the two
  dual-plane reads must require the tenant's contracts module to be enabled and the caller to hold the finance gate;
  contact-plane callers must have no access to them.
- **SPEC-13.1307**: POST /contracts must reject with a validation error (422) a name outside 1..255 characters, a
  contract_type not in {managed_services, block_hours, time_and_materials, fixed_price, warranty}, a status not in
  {draft, active, expired, cancelled, renewed}, and a billing_cycle not in {monthly, quarterly, annually, one_time,
  weekly, bi_weekly}. Omitted status must default to "draft", billing_cycle to "monthly" and auto_renew to false.
- **SPEC-13.1308**: POST /contracts must reject with a validation error keyed on end_date and message "end_date must be
  on or after start_date" when end_date is earlier than start_date; an equal end_date and an absent end_date must be
  accepted.
- **SPEC-13.1309**: POST /contracts must insert the contract under the caller's tenant and write a Create audit row with
  the new row snapshot in the same transaction, so a failed audit write must leave no contract; it must return the
  stored contract.
- **SPEC-13.1310**: PUT /contracts/{id} must change only the fields present in the body (contract_number, name, status,
  end_date, auto_renew, billing_cycle, billing_amount, sla_id, signed_date, signed_by_contact_id, notes) and keep every
  omitted field; a field cannot be reset to null through it. It must refresh updated_at, write an Update audit row
  holding the before and after snapshots in the same transaction, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Contract") when no
  row in the caller's tenant matches. A name outside 1..255, an invalid status or an invalid billing_cycle must be
  rejected with a validation error.
- **SPEC-13.1311**: DELETE /contracts/{id} must delete the contract row and write a Delete audit row holding the before
  snapshot in the same transaction, and must answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Contract") when no row in the caller's
  tenant matches.
- **SPEC-13.1312**: GET /contracts/{id}/items must return the caller's tenant's items of that contract ordered by
  sort_order, paginated with the total count; any sort parameter must be rejected with a validation error. A contract id
  with no items in the tenant must yield an empty page, not an error.
- **SPEC-13.1313**: Creating or updating a contract item must store total_price as quantity multiplied by unit_price,
  computed on the server; a client-supplied total must not be read.
- **SPEC-13.1314**: When billing_rule is omitted on a contract item write, it must be derived from item_type:
  recurring_service and retainer give every_period, one_time gives once, every other item_type (including product and
  block_hours) gives manual. A stated billing_rule (every_period, once or manual) must be stored as given.
- **SPEC-13.1315**: A contract item whose stored billing_rule is not one of every_period, once or manual must be
  reported as manual, so that it can never bill a client.
- **SPEC-13.1316**: POST /contracts/{id}/items must insert the item under the caller's tenant with billed_at null and
  write a Create audit row in the same transaction; it must return the item with the stored billing_rule and a null
  billed_at.
- **SPEC-13.1317**: PUT /contract-items/{id} must replace every writable field of the item, recompute total_price, write
  an Update audit row with before and after snapshots in the same transaction, keep and return the stored billed_at
  unchanged, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Contract item") when no row in the caller's tenant matches.
- **SPEC-13.1318**: DELETE /contract-items/{id} must delete the item and write a Delete audit row holding the before
  snapshot in the same transaction, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Contract item") when no row in the caller's
  tenant matches.
- **SPEC-13.1319**: list_recurring_items must return, for one contract in the caller's tenant, only items whose
  item_type is recurring_service or retainer, ordered by sort_order, for the billing engine.
- **SPEC-13.1320**: GET /contracts/{id}/hour-balance must return the caller's tenant's hour-balance rows of that
  contract ordered by period_start, paginated with the total count; any sort parameter must be rejected with a
  validation error, and null hours_used and rollover_hours must be reported as 0.
- **SPEC-13.1321**: GET /rate-cards must return the caller's tenant's rate cards with the default card first, then by
  name, paginated with the total count; any sort parameter must be rejected with a validation error. is_default must be
  reported as false when null.
- **SPEC-13.1322**: GET /rate-cards/{id} must answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Rate card") when no card in the caller's
  tenant has that id.
- **SPEC-13.1323**: POST /rate-cards must reject a name outside 1..100 characters with a validation error. When
  is_default is true, it must clear is_default on every other rate card of the tenant in the same transaction as the
  insert, so the tenant keeps at most one default card. It must write a Create audit row in the same transaction and
  return the card including default_per_mile_rate (null when unset).
- **SPEC-13.1324**: PUT /rate-cards/{id} must replace name, description, is_default and default_per_mile_rate, clear
  is_default on the tenant's other cards when is_default is true (all in one transaction with the update), write an
  Update audit row with before and after snapshots, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Rate card") with no change when
  the card does not exist in the tenant.
- **SPEC-13.1325**: DELETE /rate-cards/{id} must delete the card and write a Delete audit row holding the before
  snapshot in the same transaction, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Rate card") when no card in the caller's tenant
  matches.
- **SPEC-13.1326**: GET /rate-cards/{id}/items must return the items of the rate card only when the card belongs to the
  caller's tenant, each with work_type_name resolved from a work type of the same tenant (null when no such work type
  matches), paginated with the total count; any sort parameter must be rejected with a validation error.
- **SPEC-13.1327**: POST /rate-cards/{id}/items must answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Rate card") when the card is not in
  the caller's tenant; otherwise it must insert the (work_type_id, hourly_rate, after_hours_rate, emergency_rate) row
  or, when the card already has a row for that work_type_id, overwrite the three rates on it, and return the row id with
  work_type_name (null when the tenant has no such work type).
- **SPEC-13.1328**: An upsert of a rate-card item must write an Update audit row when a row for the same rate card and
  work type already existed and a Create audit row otherwise, in the same transaction as the write.
- **SPEC-13.1329**: DELETE /rate-card-items/{id} must delete the item only when its rate card belongs to the caller's
  tenant, write a Delete audit row holding the before snapshot in the same transaction, and answer 404 NOT_FOUND
  (resource "Rate card item") otherwise.
- **SPEC-13.1330**: resolve_rate must return the emergency_rate when emergency is requested, else the after_hours_rate
  when after_hours is requested, falling back to hourly_rate whenever the chosen tier is null; it must fail with 404
  NOT_FOUND (resource "Rate card item") when the tenant's rate card has no item for the work type.
- **SPEC-13.1331**: consume_hours must fail with 400 BAD_REQUEST "consume_hours: hours must be non-negative" when hours
  is below zero, before any balance is read or written.
- **SPEC-13.1332**: consume_hours must draw against the contract's block_hours item with the lowest sort_order, and must
  fail with 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Block hours contract item") when the contract has none in the caller's tenant.
- **SPEC-13.1333**: consume_hours must fail with 400 BAD_REQUEST "Date <date> is outside contract <id>'s coverage." when
  the date of `when` is before the contract's start_date or after its end_date, and must create or change no balance row
  in that case.
- **SPEC-13.1334**: The balance period for a draw must be the inclusive [period_start, period_end] window containing the
  date, with windows anchored on the contract's start_date and stepped by billing_cycle: weekly 7 days, bi_weekly 14
  days, monthly 1 month, quarterly 3 months, annually 12 months (month steps clamp to the end of a shorter month). A
  one_time or unrecognised cycle must give one window from start_date to 9999-12-31, and period_end must be the day
  before the next window starts.
- **SPEC-13.1335**: When no balance row exists for the item and period, consume_hours must create one with
  hours_included equal to the item's included_hours (0 when null), hours_used 0, hours_remaining equal to hours_included
  and rollover_hours 0.
- **SPEC-13.1336**: consume_hours must apply min(hours, max(hours_remaining, 0)) as hours_applied, increase hours_used
  and decrease hours_remaining by that amount, and report the rest as overage_hours with overage_amount equal to
  overage_hours multiplied by the item's overage_rate (0 when the rate is null). The outcome must carry the item's
  overage_rate (null when none) and the id of the debited balance row.
- **SPEC-13.1337**: A draw must lock the period's balance row (FOR UPDATE) before reading hours_remaining, so concurrent
  draws against one balance are applied one after another and never both consume the same remaining hours.
- **SPEC-13.1338**: consume_hours must commit its own transaction, while consume_hours_in_tx must perform the same draw
  inside the caller's open transaction and leave committing or rolling back to the caller.
- **SPEC-13.1339**: release_hours must add back min(applied, hours_used) to hours_remaining and subtract the same amount
  from hours_used on the named balance row (locked FOR UPDATE), so hours_used plus hours_remaining is unchanged; it must
  do nothing when applied is zero or negative, and must succeed without change when the balance row no longer exists in
  the caller's tenant.
- **SPEC-13.1340**: release_hours must commit its own transaction, while release_hours_in_tx must perform the give-back
  inside the caller's open transaction.
- **SPEC-13.1341**: roll_to_next_period must fail with 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Block hours contract item") when the
  contract has no block_hours item, and return 0 without writing when the item has rollover_enabled false or null.
- **SPEC-13.1342**: roll_to_next_period must fail with 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "closing-period balance") when no balance
  row of the item ends on closing_period_end, and otherwise lock that row and compute rolled as its hours_remaining
  (floored at 0) limited to the item's max_rollover_hours when that is set; when rolled is zero it must return 0 and
  write nothing. The closing row must not be modified.
- **SPEC-13.1343**: A positive roll must create the balance row of the period containing the day after
  closing_period_end with hours_included equal to the item's included_hours plus rolled and rollover_hours equal to
  rolled, or, when that row exists with rollover_hours 0, add rolled to its hours_included, hours_remaining and
  rollover_hours; it must return rolled.
- **SPEC-13.1344**: A second roll into a period whose balance already has non-zero rollover_hours must change nothing,
  return 0 and log at debug the contract id and closing_period_end, so repeated runs never credit the same unused hours
  twice.
- **SPEC-13.1345**: expire_due_contracts must consider only contracts with status "active" and a non-null end_date, and
  must treat a contract as due when its end_date is earlier than today in its own tenant's time zone, so no contract is
  processed before its tenant's local day has passed its end date.
- **SPEC-13.1346**: A due contract with auto_renew false or null must be set to status "expired" with updated_at
  refreshed and counted in the expired total.
- **SPEC-13.1347**: A due contract with auto_renew true must be set to status "renewed" with start_date the day after
  its old end_date and end_date the last day of a term starting then; the term length must be renewal_terms.term_months
  when that is a non-negative integer, else the whole-month difference between the old start_date and end_date (calendar
  month difference, minimum 1), and the contract must be counted in the renewed total.
- **SPEC-13.1348**: expire_due_contracts must drain each tenant in transactions of at most 200 contracts (ordered by id,
  rows locked), committing after every batch and stopping when a batch is empty, and each renewed or expired contract
  must get an Update audit row with before and after snapshots and a system actor, written in the same transaction as
  the change.
- **SPEC-13.1349**: expire_due_contracts must return (renewed, expired) counts, and a database or time-zone read failure
  must propagate as an error instead of being counted; batches committed before the failure stay committed.
- **SPEC-13.1350**: The contract lifecycle job, named "contract_lifecycle", must run expire_due_contracts at the current
  time, log at info the renewed and expired counts only when either is non-zero, and return the error of a failed sweep
  to the scheduler.
- **SPEC-13.1351**: Staff callers of GET /quotes, GET /quotes/{id} and GET /quotes/{id}/pdf must hold the role
  super_admin, admin or finance, else 403 "Insufficient permissions" (401 when the staff context has no user); every
  other quotes route (POST, PUT, DELETE on /quotes, the line routes, send, delivery-options, convert) must require the
  tenant's billing module and the finance gate.
- **SPEC-13.1352**: Every quote read and write must run in a transaction scoped to the caller's tenant and filter by
  tenant_id, so a quote, line or company of another tenant is never returned or changed.
- **SPEC-13.1353**: GET /quotes must return the caller's tenant's quotes, optionally filtered by exact company_id, exact
  stored status string, and q as a case-insensitive substring match on title or quote_number (q longer than 200
  characters must be rejected with a validation error), paginated with the filtered total. The sort field must be one of
  created_at (default), valid_until, total or title, else the request must be rejected with an unknown-sort error.
- **SPEC-13.1354**: A contact-plane caller of GET /quotes must hold quotes:read and must receive only quotes of the
  session's own company whose stored status is sent, accepted, declined, expired or converted, with the matching total;
  the sort field must be one of created_at (default), valid_until or total.
- **SPEC-13.1355**: GET /quotes/{id} for a staff caller must return the quote with its lines ordered by sort_order then
  creation time and with company_name, and must answer 404 NOT_FOUND (resource "Quote") when the quote is not in the
  caller's tenant. Lists must return lines as null.
- **SPEC-13.1356**: A contact-plane caller of GET /quotes/{id} must hold quotes:read, and a quote of another company or
  one whose status is not client-visible (draft, submitted, approved, rejected, cancelled) must answer 404 NOT_FOUND
  (resource "Quote") exactly as a missing quote does.
- **SPEC-13.1357**: A quote stored as sent whose valid_until is earlier than the reader's today (the staff user's time
  zone, or the contact's) must be reported with status expired in every read, while the stored status stays sent; no
  other status must be reinterpreted by date.
- **SPEC-13.1358**: Quote responses must carry company_name resolved within the caller's tenant, and null when the
  company row cannot be found.
- **SPEC-13.1359**: GET /quotes/{id}/pdf must first load the quote (staff: any quote in the tenant; contact:
  quotes:download_pdf and the issued-only own-company rule, 404 otherwise) and then answer 501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED with a
  plain-text message that PDF download is not yet wired.
- **SPEC-13.1360**: POST /quotes must reject with a validation error a title outside 1..255 characters, a summary over
